880.description: Defeat the Overfiend, Ibomez the Flesh Sculptor, the Gravelight Sentry, the Flesh Abomination, the Lord Warden's Council, and Lord Warden Dusk in Veteran Imperial City Prison.

1122.name: Blockbuster
1122.description: Free prisoners from their cell blocks in Imperial City Prison.

1128.name: No Prison Can Hold Me
1128.description: Defeat all mini-boss and boss enemies in Veteran Imperial City Prison within forty five minutes of starting the dungeon. Timer starts when players enter the Bastion.

1129.name: Life Sentence
1129.description: Defeat all mini-boss and boss enemies in Veteran Imperial City Prison without suffering a group member death.

1130.name: Vigilant Watcher Slayer
1130.description: Defeat 50 Vigilant Watchers in Veteran Imperial City Prison.

1131.name: Mindshriven Slayer
1131.description: Defeat 300 Mindshriven in Veteran Imperial City Prison.

1133.name: Out of Sight
1133.description: In Imperial City Prison, defeat the Overfiend, Ibomez the Flesh Sculptor, the Gravelight Sentry, the Flesh Abomination, and Lord Warden Dusk without any group member being noticed by the Vigilant Watchers.

1142.name: Darklight Dancer
1142.description: Defeat the Lord Warden Dusk of Imperial City Prison while you and your group members avoid every Darklight Burst.

1303.name: Lord Warden's Retaliation
1303.description: In Veteran Imperial City Prison, destroy the Warden's Tome, then defeat Lord Warden Dusk.

1345.name: Imperial City Prison Vanquisher
1345.description: Defeat the Overfiend, Ibomez the Flesh Sculptor, the Gravelight Sentry, the Flesh Abomination, the Lord Warden's Council, and Lord Warden Dusk in the Imperial City Prison.

1120.name: White-Gold Tower Conqueror
1120.description: Defeat the Adjudicator, the Elite Guard, the Planar Inhibitor, and Molag Kena in Veteran White-Gold Tower.

1132.name: Imperial City Challenger
1132.description: Complete the listed Challenges for veteran dungeons in Imperial City.

1275.name: First to the Top
1275.description: Defeat the Adjudicator, the Empress Regent's Guard, the Planar Inhibitor, and Molag Kena in Veteran White-Gold Tower within 30 minutes of starting the dungeon. Timer starts when you enter Green Emperor Way.

1276.name: To Spite a Tharn
1276.description: Defeat the Adjudicator, the Empress Regent's Guard, the Planar Inhibitor, and Molag Kena in Veteran White-Gold Tower without experiencing the death of a group member.

1277.name: Horn Breaker
1277.description: Defeat 100 Xivkyn in Veteran White-Gold Tower.

1278.name: Daedroth Dropper
1278.description: Defeat 75 Daedroth in Veteran White-Gold Tower.

1279.name: Ire of the Storm
1279.description: In Veteran White-Gold Tower, complete the ritual listed in the Obelisk Tome, then defeat Molag Kena.

1280.name: Entry Denied
1280.description: In Veteran White-Gold Tower, destroy all portals to prevent the arrival of the Planar Inhibitor's reinforcements.

1281.name: Imperial Transgressions
1281.description: Locate and interact with all of the speaking stones in the White-Gold Tower.

1306.name: Out of the Frying Pan
1306.description: In Veteran White-Gold Tower, become completely engulfed in flame by the Planar Inhibitor's Heat Stroke attack before it completes its Daedric Catastrophe attack. Then stay alive until the Planar Inhibitor is defeated.

1346.name: White-Gold Tower Vanquisher
1346.description: Defeat the Adjudicator, the Elite Guard, the Planar Inhibitor, and Molag Kena in White-Gold Tower.

119805.description: When placed in your home, allows you to craft Blacksmithing items in the Noble's Conquest item set.

119806.name: Blacksmithing Station (Redistributor)
119806.description: When placed in your home, allows you to craft Blacksmithing items in the Redistributor item set.

119807.name: Blacksmithing Station (Armor Master)
119807.description: When placed in your home, allows you to craft Blacksmithing items in the Armor Master item set.

119808.name: Blacksmithing Station (Law of Julianos)
119808.description: When placed in your home, allows you to craft Blacksmithing items in the Law of Julianos item set.

119809.name: Blacksmithing Station (Trial by Fire)
119809.description: When placed in your home, allows you to craft Blacksmithing items in the Trial by Fire item set.

119810.name: Blacksmithing Station (Armor of the Code)
119810.description: When placed in your home, allows you to craft Blacksmithing items in the Armor of the Code item set.

119811.name: Blacksmithing Station (Morkuldin)
119811.description: When placed in your home, allows you to craft Blacksmithing items in the Morkuldin item set.

119812.name: Blacksmithing Station (Tava's Favor)
119812.description: When placed in your home, allows you to craft Blacksmithing items in the Tava's Favor item set.

119813.name: Blacksmithing Station (Clever Alchemist)
119813.description: When placed in your home, allows you to craft Blacksmithing items in the Clever Alchemist item set.

119814.name: Blacksmithing Station (Eternal Hunt)
119814.description: When placed in your home, allows you to craft Blacksmithing items in the Eternal Hunt item set.

119815.name: Blacksmithing Station (Kvatch Gladiator)
119815.description: When placed in your home, allows you to craft Blacksmithing items in the Kvatch Gladiator item set.

119816.name: Blacksmithing Station (Varen's Legacy)
119816.description: When placed in your home, allows you to craft Blacksmithing items in the Varen's Legacy item set.

119817.name: Blacksmithing Station (Pelinal's Wrath)
119817.description: When placed in your home, allows you to craft Blacksmithing items in the Pelinal's Wrath item set.

119823.name: Tanzelwil Culanda Stone
119823.description: The bright golden light of this crystal has illuminated the honored tombs at Tanzelwil for generations.

119824.name: Veiled Crystal
119824.description: Though the sealing magic this crystal once held is broken, it still emits a soft light.

119825.name: Mehrunes Dagon Brazier
119825.description: This brazier once held a Sigil Stone capable of maintaining a gate to the Deadlands.

119826.name: High Elf Throne
119826.description: Queen Ayrenn favors a simple, elegant throne of marble and gold, a style that has become popular among her supporters.

119827.name: Ancient High Elf Statue
119827.description: The High Elves maintain these statues represent their honored ancestors, though some scholars insist they're of Ayleid design.

119828.name: Ayleid Throne
119828.description: Based on a design favored by Laloriaran Dynar, last king of the Ayleids.

119829.name: Shackle Control Stone
119829.description: Crafted from ebony-alloy cold-iron in Coldharbour's Black Forge.

119830.name: Coldharbour Chandelier
119830.description: The cold blue light from this pillar of crystal has illuminated cruelties beyond measure.

119831.name: Cowering Statue
119831.description: An effigy representing all those who recoil in fear before the cruel domination of Molag Bal.

119832.name: Light of Meridia
119832.description: A shining remembrance of the broad spectrum of heroes who fight for Meridia.

119833.name: Molag Bal Banner
119833.description: A banner brought back in triumph from the heroic challenges of Coldharbour.

119834.name: Aulus's Captive Audience
119834.description: It's comforting to know that at least one person will stick around until the end of your speech.

119835.name: Ukaezai's Ward
119835.description: With any luck, this petrified Ayleid never even felt the loss of his arm.  Or his head.

119836.name: Guardian Mane
119836.description: Normally found protecting holy sites of the Khajiit, this guardian statue was excavated from the Falinesti Winter Site—lending new credence to the legends of Rajhin's activity in the area.

119837.name: Orrery Control Pillar Replica
119837.description: Daraneth crafted several such replicas as part of her studies on the Osseous Orrery.

119838.name: Valenwood Brazier
119838.description: An eternal fire commemorating heroic achievements on the behalf of the citizens of Grahtwood.

119839.name: Fires of the Wilderking
119839.description: The ancient legend of the Wilderking turned out to be the living truth of modern Greenshade.

119840.name: Sea Elf Banner
119840.description: A banner originally taken as a trophy, following the defeat of the invading Maormer at Seaside Sanctuary.

119841.name: Hectahame Arboretum Relic
119841.description: This human skull emits a peculiar light, reminiscent of the night sky.

119842.name: Wood Elf Path Marker
119842.description: The Wood Elves could find their way through Valenwood blindfolded—these markers are instead for their guests, who may not find the forests so welcoming.

119843.name: Wood Orc Dream Catcher
119843.description: It's well documented that Wood Orc shamans collect dreams, but what they do with them is a closely guarded secret.

119844.name: Wood Orc Malacath Banner
119844.description: Like their cousins in northern Tamriel, most Wood Orcs honor Malacath.

119845.name: Wood Elf Union Trellis
119845.description: One tree may bend or break in the storm, but two together can support each other through any weather.

119846.name: Handfast Pedestal
119846.description: An altar for solemnizing the sacred marriage vows of the Wood Elves.

119847.name: Handfast
119847.description: A memorial for the heroic resolution of the Bosmeri existential crisis in Malabal Tor.

119848.name: Colovian Projection Crystal
119848.description: This crystal emits a gentle violet glow, even while separated from the rest of the projection apparatus.

119849.name: Moonmont Lunar Altar
119849.description: Attuned to the light of the two moons, this shrine can be refocused to several different lunar phases.

119850.name: Khajiiti Shrine Guardian Statue
119850.description: These stylized senche-cats can be found watching over shrines throughout Reaper's March.

119851.name: Waxing Moons Wall Tile
119851.description: Depicts Jone and Jode, both in the waxing phase.

119852.name: Waning Moons Tile
119852.description: Depicts Jone and Jode, both in the waning phase.

119853.name: Full Moons Tile
119853.description: Depicts Jone and Jode, both full and bright.

119854.name: New Moons Tile
119854.description: Depicts Jone and Jode, both new and dark.

119855.name: Wyrdstone
119855.description: Marks an area that is under the protection of the Beldama Wyrd.

119856.name: Torn Lion Guard Banner
119856.description: The Lion Guard are at their strongest with their backs against a wall.

119857.name: Breton Gravewatcher Statue
119857.description: These enormous statues were originally commisioned to watch over the dead in Cath Bedraud.

119858.name: Bloodthorn Vines, Small
119858.description: These vines show no sign of further growth, but their gentle movement still disquiets.

119862.name: Hagraven Totem
119862.description: Folk legends claim that if you camp in the Hag Fens, you will awaken to find yourself rooted in place, your body slowly twisting into the form of a withered tree.

119863.name: Knights of the Flame Banner
119863.description: A banner representing the noble knightly order of Alcaire in High Rock.

119864.name: Spirit Warden Azura Statue
119864.description: A replica of the celebrated statue of Azura in Pariah Abbey.

119865.name: Wayrest Guillotine
119865.description: Nightmares about guillotines are remarkably common in Wayrest.

119866.name: Replica Dreamshard
119866.description: Witnesses confirm that this replica is faithful to the original appearance of the mystical object.

119867.name: Vaermina Statue
119867.description: Originally commisioned by a noble to give a face to the nightmares that plagued him night after a night. It didn't help.

119868.name: Constellation Tile: The Ritual
119868.description: Recovered from ruins in the Doomcrag, this tile depicts the constellation of The Ritual.

119869.name: Constellation Tile: The Shadow
119869.description: Recovered from ruins in the Doomcrag, this tile depicts the constellation of The Shadow.

119870.name: Constellation Tile: The Tower
119870.description: Recovered from ruins in the Doomcrag, this tile depicts the constellation of The Tower.

119871.name: Wagon of Death
119871.description: You're going to give these people an honest burial, right?

119872.name: Tamrith Coffin Lid
119872.description: It's said that the dead rise so often in Rivenspire that they put the handles on the insides of the coffin lids.

119873.name: Tamrith Coffin
119873.description: Make your bedroom a dead-room with a coffin from haunted Rivenspire.

119875.name: Gargoyle Statue
119875.description: Originally found in the vampire-infested ruins of Shadowfate Cavern, it has shown no sign of animating. Yet.

119876.name: Tu'whacca's Brazier
119876.description: Used in the worship of Tu'whacca, who guides the fallen to the Far Shores.

119877.name: Reconstructed Necromantic Focus
119877.description: This has an unsettling habit of spontaneously reconstructing itself when destroyed.

119878.name: Standing Ansei Statue
119878.description: The triumph of the Ansei will never be forgotten.

119879.name: Kneeling Ansei Statue
119879.description: The sacrifice of the Ansei will never be forgotten.

119880.name: Replica of Shattered Ansei Sword
119880.description: The remains of one of several decoys commisioned by King Fahara'jad.

119881.name: Glenmoril Wyrd Stone
119881.description: The prevailing theory is that the red pigment on these stones is derived from a rare crimson flower, and is not the "blood of trespassing children," as claimed by some in Evermore.

119882.name: Damaged Knight of St. Pelin Statue
119882.description: Damaged in Septima Tharn's assault on Bangkorai Garrison.

119883.name: Evermore Mourning Banner
119883.description: In Evermore, those who have lost a loved one display their mourning banner on a spear, to represent the wound in their heart.

119884.name: Ragged Imperial Banner
119884.description: One of the few relatively intact banners recovered following the Imperial occupation of Southern Bangkorai.

119885.name: Ceremonial Redguard Vessel
119885.description: This massive bowl is traditionally used as a brazier for rites honoring the fallen.

119887.name: Serien's Stand
119887.description: A remembrance of the last stand of the obstreperous General Serien.

119888.name: Lacquered Kwama Egg
119888.description: An exquisite painted trophy memorializing heroic triumphs in Stonefalls.

119889.name: Daedric Sconce
119889.description: An ominous light source pillaged from Oblivion.

119890.name: Blood Fountain
119890.description: A grim reminder that the victories in Stonefalls were not without a price.

119892.name: Remnant of Balreth
119892.description: A hunk of bone and char, left over from the defeat of Balreth.

119893.name: Mimic Hist Tree
119893.description: A convincing replica of one of the mystically-sentient trees revered by the Argonians.

119897.name: Argonian Egg
119897.description: A replica of an egg of the reptilian Argonians of Shadowfen.

119898.name: Replica Mnemic Egg
119898.description: Following attempts by the Aldmeri Dominion to capture the Mnemic Egg, several replicas were created to foil future attempts.

119899.name: Replica Stone Nest
119899.description: Traditionally, the dais that holds Mnemic Egg is referred to as its nest.

119900.name: Oblivion Stone
119900.description: A dark chunk of raw stone, branded with the Daedric sigil Khot.

119901.name: Lob's Challenge Horn
119901.description: Winding this horn in Giant country could have hazardous results.

119904.name: Standing Slab
119904.description: This menhir of the ancient Nords stands in solemn tribute to the hero of Eastmarch.

119905.name: Dragon Shrine Altar
119905.description: Long ago the ancient Nords worshiped living Dragons at altars like this one.

119906.name: Throne of the Skald-King
119906.description: A replica of the throne of High King Jorunn granted in gratitude for services to Eastmarch.

119907.name: Visage of the Skald
119907.description: A traditional trophy of high-ranking bards of Skyrim.

119908.name: Swamp Anemone
119908.description: A living trophy and constant reminder of the lush fungal foliage of Deshaan.

119910.name: Veloth's Reliquary
119910.description: Relish this replica reliquary for retaining relics of the revered Veloth.

119911.name: Tribunal Rug
119911.description: A circular rug, emblazoned with the bronze symbol of the Tribunal.

119913.name: Tribunal Altar
119913.description: Each side of this pillar represents one of the three members of the Tribunal: Almalexia, Sotha Sil, and Vivec.

119914.name: Touch of Plague
119914.description: A sealed container, believed to hold a sample of the Llodos plague.

119915.name: Ancient Cultist Totem
119915.description: Legend claims that the skulls beneath Fallowstone Vault hark back to the age of the Dragon Cult.

119916.name: Ysgramor Statue
119916.description: A statue honoring the Nord culture hero Ysgramor, "The Harbinger of us all."

119918.name: Statue of the Wolf
119918.description: A recreation of the statue that has sat outside Fallowstone Hall for longer than anyone can remember.

119920.name: Totem of the Reach
119920.description: This totem doesn't seem to carry the usual death curse. No one's died yet, at least.

119922.name: Torn Worm Cult Banner
119922.description: One of many trophies taken following the defeat of the Worm Cult in The Rift.

119923.name: Serpent Stone
119923.description: A Craglorn-style trophy awarded to commemorate victory in the Dragonstar Arena.

119925.name: Nirncrux Bowl
119925.description: The rare material Nirncrux is so prized by the miners of Craglorn that it is conveyed in special bowls.

119929.name: Snake Prayer Tile
119929.description: A holy symbol of the ancient Nedes denoting a location of worship.

119930.name: Totem of the Serpent
119930.description: A memorial commemorating the defeat of the Serpent Constellation's machinations in Craglorn.

119931.name: Craglorn Tapestry
119931.description: A reconstruction of the famous tapestry depicting the conflict of the Constellations.

119933.name: Craglorn Brazier
119933.description: A brazier originally used by one of the ancient and nigh-forgotten cultures of Craglorn.

119934.name: Craglorn Sconce
119934.description: A light source crafted in the style of the ancient Ra Gada conquerors of Craglorn.

119935.name: Observatory Banner
119935.description: This long banner depicts a stylized and ordered version of the sky, as observed by the Stargazers of Craglorn.

119936.name: Poisoned Blood
119936.description: This is a small house item.

119937.name: Gold Coast Estate Keg
119937.description: A keg of Anvil malmsey to mark the expert infiltration skills of a Dark Brotherhood initiate.

119938.name: Light and Shadow
119938.description: This is a small house item.

119939.name: Hourglass Rug
119939.description: A rug stolen from those officious knights of the Order of the Hour.

119940.name: Sanctuary Sconce
119940.description: This light source is a reminder of the tasteful and restrained décor of the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary.

119941.name: Brotherhood Poison Vial
119941.description: An ornamental copy of one of the Dark Brotherhood's bottled toxins.

119944.name: Order of the Hour Banner
119944.description: A banner "borrowed" from the Akatosh-worshiping knights of the Order of the Hour.

119945.name: Dark Brotherhood Banner
119945.description: This hanging banner announces one's membership in the Dark Brotherhood. Display it with caution.

119947.name: Banner of the Kvatch Guard
119947.description: The noble wolf's-head banner of the respected Kvatch Guard.

119948.name: Statue of the Mother
119948.description: No one would be so bold as to assert without contradiction that this is a statue representing the Night Mother.

119950.name: Preserved Sweetrolls
119950.description: A cluster of sweetrolls—a delicious trophy that commemorates thwarting the Sweetroll Killer of the Gold Coast.

119951.name: Litany of Blood
119951.description: A replica of the Dark Brotherhood's sinister tome of death.

119952.name: Sacrificial Heart
119952.description: This is a small house item.

119953.name: Dark Ledger
119953.description: Every Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary has a book that balances the costs of living against the wages of death.

119954.name: Reliquary Skull
119954.description: A replica of the Giovessen Skull, a relic whose history extends back nearly 600 years.

119955.name: Pale Garden Flowers
119955.description: These flowers are a reminder of how short and ephemeral a thief's life can be.

119960.name: Jar of Green Dye
119960.description: Enough concentrated green dye to make Hammerfell look like Valenwood.

119961.name: An Adoring Fan
119961.description: A souvenir of your visit to an exclusive Hew's Bane soiree.

119963.name: Yokudan Puzzle Column
119963.description: Puzzle locks based on rotating stone pillars have been used in vaults and labyrinths since time immemorial. This version hails from ancient Yokuda.

119965.name: Abah's Landing Banner
119965.description: The flag of the Free and Open Trading Port of Abah's Landing.

119966.name: Iron Wheel Banner
119966.description: The banner of those over-achieving law enforcers known as the Iron Wheel.

119967.name: Vibrant Garden Flowers
119967.description: The life of a desert flower is brief but bright, so the Redguards treasure them for their gardens.

119968.name: Distracting Harpy Egg
119968.description: "The hideous harpy, half-avian abomination, is shunned by all the faithful of Tava." —The Revered Mubdaraz

119969.name: Banner of Taneth
119969.description: The esteemed banner of the Kingdom of Taneth in Hammerfell.

119970.name: Redguard Round Table
119970.description: This is a standard house item.

119971.name: Statue of Shadows
119971.description: Though all are impressed by the grave solemnity of this statue, none can agree on whom it represents.

119974.name: Hiding Place
119974.description: A typical nondescript Abah's Landing basket. No one would ever think of looking in there!

119975.name: Orsinium Cart
119975.description: An Orcish wheeled cart: they build 'em sturdy in Wrothgar.

119976.name: Orc Adventuring Backpack
119976.description: This rugged and capacious backpack is a reminder not to venture unequipped into the wilds of Wrothgar.

119977.name: Orcish War Totem
119977.description: Orcs like to announce great events by erecting symbolic totems: this one heralds war.

119978.name: Orcish Battle Totem
119978.description: Orcs like to announce great events by erecting symbolic totems: this one foretells battle.

119979.name: Fur Throne
119979.description: If you were an Orc chieftain in frozen Wrothgar, you'd want furs on your throne, too.

119980.name: Orcish Totem
119980.description: Orcs like to announce events by erecting symbolic totems: this one marks territory.

119981.name: Throne of the Orc King
119981.description: A replica of the throne entitled by tradition to the Orc chief who unites the clans into a kingdom.

119982.name: Molag Bal Brazier
119982.description: This Coldharbour brazier commemorates the thwarting of Molag Bal's last-ditch attack on Nirn.

119983.name: Imperial Banner
119983.description: A banner earned for plumbing the labyrinth of sewers beneath the Imperical City.

119984.name: Pirate Banner
119984.description: Proudly fly the flag of Abecean piracy after recruiting freebooters for a daring venture.

119986.name: Maormer Totem
119986.description: A symbol of the perfidious Sea Elves of Pyandonea.

119987.name: Coldharbour Urn
119987.description: Replica of an urn as found in the Wailing Prison in Coldharbour. Because you always remember your first iron dagger.

119988.name: Replica Soul Gem
119988.description: A copy of one of the mysterious and mystical crystals used to capture the souls of dying entities.

119989.name: Replica Black Soul Gem
119989.description: An imitation of one of those sinister crystals used to entrap the souls of dying sentient beings.

119990.name: Soul Gem Case
119990.description: The sort of case sorcerers and necromancers use to keep their soul gems safe, clean, and shiny.

119991.name: Spare Flesh Atronach Parts
119991.description: Unlike most summoned Daedra, the Flesh Atronach requires some pre-assembly.

119992.name: Soul Gem Crate
119992.description: The sort of crate sorcerers and necromancers use to keep their soul gems safe, clean, and shiny.

119993.name: Lantern of Anguish
119993.description: The crimson light from this lantern complements either torture or seduction equally well.

119994.name: Depleted Sigil Stone
119994.description: A mystic runestone, now drained, once used to hold open an Oblivion gate.

119995.name: Silent Sentinel
119995.description: A solemn reminder of the heroic effort to challenge the schemes of Molag Bal.

119996.name: Soul Gem Stand
119996.description: Just the thing for displaying your cruel magical implement used to enslave creatures' souls.

119997.name: The Final Threat
119997.description: Molag Bal has had countless such statues erected in his name, and woe unto he who mocks their craftsmanship or artistry.

119999.name: Daedric Chest
119999.description: The heroism of dauntless slayers of Daedra is marked by presentation of a chest stolen from Oblivion.

120000.name: Broken Chain
120000.description: Links from the fallen chain of a shattered Dark Anchor.

120001.name: Decorative Treasure Chest
120001.description: Someone so relentlessly dedicated to the pursuit of treasure deserves such an ornamental coffer.

120002.name: Dueling Banner
120002.description: A banner representing a challenge to the death. Only a supremely confident duelist would decorate their home with such a thing.

120003.name: Cheese Cutter
120003.description: When the Mages Guild won away Eveyea from Sheogorath, the Madgod presented them with a supply of cheese cutters to award as guild prizes.

120005.name: Soul Gem, Common
120005.description: This is a small house item.

120008.name: Soul Gem, Lesser
120008.description: This is a small house item.

120011.name: Mages Guild Banner
120011.description: A banner presented to one who has more than earned the right to display Mages Guild affiliation.

120019.name: Fighters Guild Banner
120019.description: A banner presented to one who has more than earned the right to display Fighters Guild affiliation.

120023.name: Outlaw Banner
120023.description: A banner proudly displaying the covert three-bladed symbol of Tamriel's outlaws. (Wait, that's supposed to be secret!)

120025.name: Pile of Coins
120025.description: This replica treasure looks just like a real pile of coins, doesn't it?

120026.name: Mountain of Loot
120026.description: Never lack for a packed stack of black market fake drakes.

120027.name: Mass Tombstone
120027.description: A grim memorial to the staggering number of creatures you've massacred in cold blood.

120028.name: Death Marker
120028.description: Yeah, well, they probably had it coming.

120029.name: Noble Pocket Lint
120029.description: You've picked so many pockets, the ends of your fingers are chapped.

120030.name: Pocket Change
120030.description: So now you're a creeping, furtive sneak thief. Wouldn't your parents be so proud?

120031.name: Replica Key Blank
120031.description: Copy of an item perfect for creating illicit copies of a "borrowed" key, or for fashioning into a bump key.

120032.name: Decorative Thieves Trove
120032.description: Every time you looted one of these, you thought, "I wish I had one." And now you do.

120033.name: Decorative Safebox
120033.description: In the vicinity of such a master cracksman, it's possible that "safebox" is a bit of a misnomer.

120034.name: Undaunted Mug
120034.description: A ceremonial mug presented in the name of true Undaunted camaraderie!

120035.name: Undaunted Chest
120035.description: A handsome chest for all the loot collected on missions performed for the Undaunted.

120036.name: Undaunted Banner
120036.description: A banner presented to one who has more than earned the right to display affiliation with the Undaunted.

120037.name: Decorative Skyshard
120037.description: This mystic crystal commemorates the colossal achievement of finding skyshards all across Tamriel.

120038.name: Throne of Cyrodiil
120038.description: Even in the tumult of the Three Banners War, sitting atop the Ruby Throne is a rare and coveted privilege.

120039.name: Primal Altar to Hircine
120039.description: Display your feral devotion to the Father of Manbeasts with this rustic altar.

120040.name: Crimson-Stained Bowl
120040.description: Baron Montclair preferred to drink from a shallow bowl, claiming that it enhanced bouquet, while allowing just enough coagulation to give a pleasing texture on the tongue.

120043.name: Fishing Vessel
120043.description: Though a master fisher needs only bait and line, most own a small and steady sailboat for lazy Sundas excursions.

120044.name: Alchemist's Sign
120044.description: A sign with the symbol used by all those who can tell an alembic from a calcinator.

120045.name: Poison Satchel
120045.description: Poison-making is a skill abhorrent to most citizens of Tamriel, so keep this distinctive satchel a secret.

120046.name: Blacksmith's Sign
120046.description: A sign earned by one who's become a master of the forge and hammer.

120048.name: Clothier's Sign
120048.description: A sign earned by one who's become a master of the needle and scissors.

120050.name: Enchanter's Sign
120050.description: A sign earned by one who's become a master of Aspect, Essence, and Potency.

120051.name: Enchanting Gem
120051.description: A handsome gem awarded to all those who become Potentates of Potency!

120052.name: Provisioner's Sign
120052.description: A sign earned by one who's become a master of the cooking fire and spoons.

120053.name: Chef's Cleaver
120053.description: This is bound to be a useful utensil to one who knows such a quantity of recipes.

120054.name: Woodworker's Sign
120054.description: A sign earned by one who's become a master of the chisel and saw.

120056.name: Hanging Map of Tamriel
120056.description: A well-worn map, clearly used on many a Tamrielic journey.

120057.name: Harvester's Woodpile
120057.description: A symbolic pile of precious woods awarded to a master harvester of timber.

120058.name: Harvester's Herbs
120058.description: A symbolic bunch of precious plants awarded to a master harvester of herbs.

120059.name: Harvester's Ore
120059.description: A symbolic outcropping of precious raw metal awarded to a master harvester of ore.

120060.name: Harvester's Critter Trap
120060.description: A symbolic critter trap awarded to a master harvester of lesser creatures.

120061.name: Harvester's Garden Shrub
120061.description: A symbolic flowering shrub awarded to a master harvester of floral materials.

120062.name: Smith's Bellows
120062.description: A smith who's forged as much as you could probably work a smith's hammer with closed eyes. (But don't try it.)

120063.name: Dominion Hero Shield
120063.description: This crest is awarded only to the greatest heroes of the Aldmeri Dominion.

120064.name: Covenant Hero Shield
120064.description: This crest is awarded only to the greatest heroes of the Daggerfall Covenant.

120065.name: Pact Hero Shield
120065.description: This crest is awarded only to the greatest heroes of the Ebonheart Pact.

120066.name: Display Craft Bag
120066.description: Unlike a real Craft Bag, this display version can't hold impossible amounts of crafting materials.

120075.name: Decoy Elder Scroll

151777.name: Statue, Yolnahkriin
151777.description: With spread wings, the golden statue form of Yolnahkriin can preside over your home or garden, lending it the majestic presence of a Dragon.

151778.name: Statue, Lokkestiiz
151778.description: Perched on an hourglass, the silver statue form of Lokkestiiz can impress those who visit your home.

151779.name: Moon Gate
151779.description: Add a miniature version of a Moon Gate to your home. It's the perfect size for your favorite housecat! (Just don't try to use it. It's there to make an impression, not actually work!)

151780.name: Banner, Rimmen
151780.description: Show your support for Rimmen's independence from tyranny by hanging this colorful banner in your home.

151781.name: Banner, Anequina
151781.description: The arid northern region of Elsweyr, called Anequina, has bred hearty warriors and pragmatic thinkers, though some have learned to work the land. Show your respect for the traditions of Anequina by hanging this banner in your abode.

151782.name: Khajiit Burial Mound
151782.description: Khajiit of Anequina often build cairns of local stone to mark their dead. Perhaps you need such structures for your own land?

151783.name: Replica Dragon Horn, Large
151783.description: This replica of the Dragon Horn found in Anequina can lend a certain air of majesty to your home or landscape. You might find cats or even Alfiq making use of it as a comfy sleeping spot.

151784.name: Replica Dragon Horn, Small
151784.description: Have an alcove that needs a touch of ancient charm? This small Dragon Horn replica is perfection itself for just such a space!

151785.name: Wrathstone, Replica
151785.description: Rest assured, you won't be releasing Dragons into Tamriel by possessing this replica of the ill-used Wrathstone. (Just don't let Abnur Tharn see it—unless you like pouring salt into wounds.)

151786.name: Moon Temple Pad
151786.description: That floor that seems so empty? Add some color with this Moon Temple Pad. The rich blue adds serenity to any space.

151787.name: Khajiit Lion Crest
151787.description: This fierce fellow can make any bit of wall look more imposing. An excellent touch for those seeking a sense of dominance over others. As a bonus feature, you can activate him to become a wall torch!

151788.name: Khajiit Wagon, Ruined
151788.description: Are you a fan of fake ruins? Do you want to lend a lived-in look to your garden? This Khajiit wagon is a match for both of these décor choices.

151789.name: Khajiit Wagon, Merchant
151789.description: Due to an unfortunate mishap, it cannot be used to move goods, but it certainly sets the tone for the area.

151790.name: Akaviri Table, Stone
151790.description: This hefty Akaviri table can dominate a room or help pull together the stone elements in your landscape.

151791.name: Column, Fatal Warning
151791.description: Sometimes you need to mark an area as dangerous. Or maybe you just want to provide a gentle "please do not bother me" warning to those who would pester you. This column? Excellent for both such scenarios.

151792.name: Tojay-Raht Statue, Monk
151792.description: Want to bring the elegant solemnity of an adeptorium to your home or garden? This statue, with a Khajiit adept performing a kata, will do exactly that.

151796.name: Riverhold Defense Spikes, Piled
151796.description: Everyone needs these "go away, and I mean it" spikes. Everyone. (Especially those in Riverhold.)

151797.name: Riverhold Defense Spikes, Tripod
151797.description: Are your neighbors jumping over the wall of your yard and into your garden, disturbing your hard-won natural aesthetic? Just place this tripod where they normally land, and watch the result!

151798.name: Riverhold Defense Spikes, Roof-Mounted
151798.description: These roof-mounted spikes signal to those who see them that you are definitely planning to hold your home fast against any nuisances, including Dragons.

151799.name: Projection Stone, Moons
151799.description: Both shiny and colorful, this projection stone shows the phases of the moons. Perfect for your midnight garden or bedroom!

151800.name: Cage, Small Animal
151800.description: Whether it's skeevers or pebble pals, this small cage can hold the creature or thing of your choice.

151801.name: Barrel, Riverhold
151801.description: A barrel can contain many things, such as, say, skooma stashes. But you wouldn't have any skooma, now, would you?

151802.name: Crate, Riverhold
151802.description: You might think that a crate is utilitarian, but your housecats will prize it almost as much as they prize the sound of you adding food to their "empty" bowls.

156756.description: Known for their cleansing properties, Khenarthic Bells abound in shrines and other places sacred to the Goddess of the Winds. This replica bell might not remove corruption, but its presence can remind onlookers to take a moment and breathe mindfully.

156757.name: New Moon Cult Banner, Large
156757.description: Promising much to vulnerable Khajiit, the Order of the New Moon provides a place for them to go. Yet, in halls strewn with banners such as these, many find more than they expect … or want.

156758.name: New Moon Cult Banner
156758.description: Promising much to vulnerable Khajiit, the Order of the New Moon provides a place for them to go. Yet, in halls strewn with banners such as these, many find more than they expect … or want.

156759.name: Painted Rock, Swirls
156759.description: Few settlements can match the rich artistic traditions of Black Heights. Now, the brilliant hues that guide Khajiit to the Sands Behind the Stars can enrich your personal paradise.

156760.name: Painted Rock, Life's Glory
156760.description: With strokes of vibrant colors, a Black Heights artist rendered a vision of the richness of life before starting on the path to the Sands Behind the Stars.

156761.name: Painted Rock, Heart's Ease
156761.description: The dominating reds and yellows of this rock painted in the Black Heights style can enhance the visual appeal of your garden, plus provide you with a remembrance of those who came before you.

156762.name: Map of Southern Elsweyr, Hanging
156762.description: Also called Pellitine, Southern Elsweyr features a port city, several Khajiiti sacred places, an artist's retreat, locations of a scurrilous nature, an Imperial citadel, and plenty of stories both brilliant and dark.

156763.name: Senchal Banner
156763.description: The blue and gold Senchal banner features lunar symbolism, reflecting the Khajiit's cultural reverence for the moons Jone and Jode.

160541.description: When placed in your home, allows you to dye your worn equipment and customize your outfits.

161204.name: Anvil of Old Orsinium
161204.description: Add a touch of Old Orsinium to your home with this well-crafted anvil and cinder-dousing bearskin rug.

161205.name: Void-Crystal Anomaly
161205.description: Floating serenely, these black crystals provide an unsettling focal point to any garden or room.

161206.name: Branch of Falinesti
161206.description: Formed by the Bosmer tree shapers of the Walking City, this throne subtly conforms to whomever sits upon it, providing strangely comfortable seating from this ancient hardwood.

161207.name: Hollowbone Wind Chimes
161207.description: This mix of bone, metal, and sinew provides a strangely soothing and meditative sound.

161208.name: Rune-Carved Mammoth Skull
161208.description: The metal accents on this well-dressed mammoth skull add much to its impressive staging.

161209.name: Nest of Shadows
161209.description: Deadly and dramatic, this metal serpent encircles, and some say threatens, the lavender-hued egg nestled in its coils.

161210.name: Prismatic Sunbird Feather
161210.description: Gloriously stunning doesn't even begin to describe this unusual feather. Allow it to light up a dark nook or perhaps place it front and center in your personal collection of eye-catching objects.

161211.name: Remnant of the False Tower
161211.description: Rich rose-hued colors delight the eye when gazing upon this unusual stone remnant.

161212.name: Silvenari Sap-Stone
161212.description: This lovely sap-stone can add both a touch of the Green and dramatic flair to any wall you choose to place it upon.

161213.name: Sorcerer-King's Blade
161213.description: Complete with its own stone display furnishing, this broken blade was once wielded by an Ayleid ruler who held mastery over great magic.

161214.name: Spellscar Shard
161214.description: This captivating shard of the great obelisk retains just enough energy to emit a dramatic fire and electrical show.

161215.name: Yokudan Skystone Scabbard
161215.description: Imagine what the sword that belonged to this stunning scabbard might have looked like! As it stands, the scabbard alone deserves all the attention it garners.

161216.name: Tri-Angled Truth Altar
161216.description: With markings that show veneration to old gods, this splendid altar required consummate geometric knowledge to create.

163432.name: Music Box, The Merry Meadmaker
163432.description: When activated, plays a music box arrangement of the jaunty "The Merry Meadmaker" composition.

163704.name: Kingmaker's Trove
163704.description: Eye-catching, is it not? This gorgeous chest requires more than a second look to take in all its masterful filigree and accents.

163705.name: Warcaller's Painted Drum
163705.description: No musical instrument collection is complete without this massive drum. When used, all who hear it feel its beat deep within their bones.

163706.name: Dwemer Star Chart
163706.description: Show off your love of Dwarven astronomical knowledge by placing this wondrous star chart in your home.

163707.name: Antique Map of Glenumbra
163707.description: This detailed map highlights the complex topography of Glenumbra thanks to the artistry of the cartographer who crafted it.

163708.name: Antique Map of Stormhaven
163708.description: Even early maps of Stormhaven like this one show population centers, making the map a window into the past.

163709.name: Antique Map of Rivenspire
163709.description: Somehow the cartographer behind this map accurately rendered Rivenspire in great detail through all its gloom and fog.

163710.name: Antique Map of Alik'r Desert
163710.description: This map maker's aesthetic depicts the vast desert of Alik'r in gentle flowing lines, representing dunes that have long since shifted.

163711.name: Antique Map of Bangkorai
163711.description: The entire region of Bangkorai is shown on this antique map, though much of the detail is focused on the daunting Bangkorai pass.

163712.name: Antique Map of Stonefalls
163712.description: Though the ashfall may obscure the features of Stonefalls, the clear lines of this map are an able guide.

163713.name: Antique Map of Deshaan
163713.description: The fertile plain of Deshaan stretches out on this artful map.

163714.name: Antique Map of Shadowfen
163714.description: On this aged map, someone took great pains to depict the common paths and hazardous areas of the mire called Shadowfen.

163715.name: Antique Map of Eastmarch
163715.description: A master cartographer lent their skills to the crafting of this map of Eastmarch untold years ago.

163716.name: Antique Map of The Rift
163716.description: Despite its name, the sweeping temperate zone called the Rift is a hospitable place for Nords to come together, and this map points the way.

163717.name: Antique Map of Auridon
163717.description: One of the Summerset Isles, Auridon is painstakingly rendered on this map to the exacting standard of the College of Sapiarchs.

163718.name: Antique Map of Grahtwood
163718.description: Careful attention was paid to marking the well-trod footpaths through the old growth of Grahtwood.

163719.name: Antique Map of Greenshade
163719.description: Nearly a work of art in itself, this map of Greenshade provides some insight into what the region might have looked like in an earlier time.

163720.name: Antique Map of Malabal Tor
163720.description: The cartographer paid special attention to the coast and waterways of Malabal Tor when rendering this map.

163721.name: Antique Map of Reaper's March
163721.description: Skillful strokes create the boundaries and landmarks of Reaper's March on this map.

163722.name: Antique Map of Tamriel
163722.description: Though it details only major settlements and provincial boundaries, this continental map of Tamriel makes a good frame of reference for world travelers.

163723.name: Antique Map of Wrothgar
163723.description: The treacherous mountains of Wrothgar are expertly depicted on this map, though safe passage through them is anyone's guess.

163724.name: Antique Map of Vvardenfell
163724.description: The vastness of Red Mountain is truly apparent in this scale map of Vvardenfell.

163725.name: Antique Map of Summerset
163725.description: While one wouldn't want to use this map for navigation, given its age, it makes for excellent wall art.

163726.name: Antique Map of Murkmire
163726.description: The surveyor who succeeded in mapping the impenetrable marshlands of Murkmire made certain to note the migration of swamp leviathans.

163727.name: Antique Map of Northern Elsweyr
163727.description: The lands of Anequina and its majestic aqueduct are the subject of this skillfully illustrated map.

163728.name: Antique Map of Southern Elsweyr
163728.description: The kingdom of Pellitine stretches out like a lazing senche on this artistically rendered map.

165848.name: Font of Auri-El
165848.description: Nestled inside this massive stone edifice shines a glowing symbol of Auri-El, King of the Aldmer.

165849.name: Echoes of Aldmeris
165849.description: This triptych may stir ancestral memories in Mer—a longing of the soul for home. Or so the antiquarian claimed.

165850.name: Mnemonic Star-Sphere
165850.description: Experts continue to deduce the purpose of this device, but for now it serves as a memorable decoration.

165851.name: Sixth House Ritual Table
165851.description: Scholars of House Dagoth would find this ornate table both beautiful and thrilling—a marvel to admire, far away from Ordinators.

165852.name: St. Nerevar, Moon-and-Star
165852.description: Behold the Champion of Azura, the Hero of Red Mountain, the Herald of the Triune Way, Saint Nerevar Moon-and-Star in all his glory from the comfort of your own home.

165853.name: Moons-Blessed Ceremonial Pool
165853.description: Khajiiti legends claim that moon sugar comes from the light of the Two Moons trapped in the blessed waters of their homeland. The wondrous twinkling of this moonpool would lead you to believe it.

165854.name: Nisswo's Soul Tender
165854.description: This pedestal is considered sacred to the "nothing speakers" of Sithis, but it is believed to play a part in the eternal cycle of creation and destruction.

165855.name: Noble Knight's Rest
165855.description: Become the caretaker of this knight's sarcophagus and remains—but take your duties to heart lest you end up haunted!

165856.name: Sacred Chalice of Ysgramor
165856.description: Whether you choose to honor the Harbinger by keeping this chalice on display or by filling it with the best mead in Skyrim, it will serve you well.

165857.name: Brazier of Frozen Flame
165857.description: With its dazzling mix of sapphire and silver hues, this brazier lights up dramatically with an icy blaze.

165858.name: Coil of Satakal
165858.description: Call guests to dinner with this stunning ceremonial gong. Just don't be surprised if your guests aim to consume more than what you prepared.

165859.name: The Dutiful Guar
165859.description: This guar looks so real it could draw breath, leading some to suggest the subject of this piece lies beneath the bronze.

165860.name: Eight-Star Chandelier
165860.description: Brighten up a large space with this welkynd-stone chandelier dedicated to the blessed Eight.

165861.name: Golden Idol of Morihaus
165861.description: Winged. Golden. Arresting, as the demigod himself. Kneel before this idol and pray for a fraction of his might!

165862.name: Moth Priest's Cleansing Bowl
165862.description: Don't mistake this humble bowl as a simple object of sanitation! This cleansing bowl is believed to have removed impurities from the fingers of Moth Priests before they went about reading the Elder Scrolls.

165863.name: St. Alessia, Paravant
165863.description: Paravant, meaning "The First," is a title given to Alessia, leader of the rebellion against the Ayleids. Perhaps you'll be the first to display "The First," eh?

165864.name: Blessed Dais of Almalexia
165864.description: Elegant. Grand. Pointed. Much like Almalexia herself. Woe unto those who would let this blessed dais fall into dust and disuse.

165865.name: Beacon of Tower Zero
165865.description: Long removed from the Direnni Tower, give the holy light of Ada-mantia a place to shine forth from your abode.

165866.name: Ashen Infernace Gate
165866.description: Foreboding and grim, this gate emanates a sense of danger and gloom. Are you fearless or foolish enough to welcome whatever might pass through it into your home?

165867.name: Cat's Eye Prism
165867.description: The strange stone on this pedestal appears to catch light as easily as it catches the eye, but how it does this remains a mystery.

165868.name: Moonlight Mirror
165868.description: Framed gorgeously, the moons dominate this mirror, making it more for gazing at than into.

165869.name: Maormeri Serpent Shrine
165869.description: The Maormer are said to tame the great serpents of the sea, but while such magnificent creatures may be out of reach, this winding statue is the next best thing.

165870.name: Daedric Pillar of Torment
165870.description: Piece of art? Or torture device? Maybe both, depending on how you choose to view it.

165871.name: Carved Whale Totem
165871.description: Crafted from opal, this whale totem expresses a sense of simple joy to some. Others, however, believe it to hold more spiritual significance.

165872.name: Stained Glass of Lunar Phases
165872.description: The Khajiit describe the changing of the Two Moons as a graceful dance, and this stained glass window somehow captures their elegance, especially under the moonlight.

165873.name: Meridian Sconce
165873.description: It's said that the light of Meridia is boundless and eternal. Sadly, the candles in this majestic sconce are neither, but the impression this installation creates is long lasting.

165874.name: Jeweled Skull of Ayleid Kings
165874.description: If skulls feature prominantly in your decor, this jeweled skull can become the crowning piece of your collection.

165875.name: Ayleid Lightwell
165875.description: Ayleids believed that four elements composed Nirn: light, earth, water, and air. Light, when used in lightwells, allowed mages to restore their energy, though this one is primarily a showpiece.

165876.name: Ruby Dragon Skull
165876.description: The size and luster of this ruby would be a magnificent addition to any Dragon's hoard, even if wasn't masterfully cut into their likeness.

165878.name: Dwarven Puzzle Box
165878.description: Is it a toy? A vault? A piece of an even more elaborate puzzle? No one will know until someone opens it.

165990.name: Mammoth Cheese, Pungent
165990.description: Some folk diplomatically state that mammoth cheese is an acquired taste. Others argue that its smell is not only pervasive but even aggressive—to the point that you don't need to eat it to taste it.

165991.name: Statue, Vampiric Sovereign
165991.description: The vile enchantments placed upon this statue make it a grim reminder of a vampire's power. Whether cloaked in bats, imbued with dark energies, or wreathed in flame, weak-hearted mortals will never forget the sight of it.

165992.name: Antique Map of Western Skyrim
165992.description: Explore the regions of Western Skyrim with this masterful map. Elevations, waterways, and roads may be a tad out of date.

165993.name: Antique Map of Coldharbour
165993.description: One might question the sanity of the cartographer of this map, but according to experts in planar travel, it's remarkably accurate.

165994.name: Antique Map of Craglorn
165994.description: The cartographer who worked on this antique map detailed the dry wastelands of Lower Craglorn and mountainous regions of Upper Craglorn with a deft hand.

165995.name: Antique Map of Cyrodiil
165995.description: Though currently ravaged by war, this map of Cyrodiil gives you a picture of earlier times in this region.

165996.name: Antique Map of the Gold Coast
165996.description: Though this antique map doesn't note it, the Gold Coast was once called the Strident Coast.

165997.name: Antique Map of Hew's Bane
165997.description: This rare map depicts Hew's Bane, also once called Khefrem's Boot, a peninsula on the south coast of Hammerfell.

166014.description: Few can resist the instinct to tuck tail and scurry from this epitome of cool, feline ferocity on display.

166015.name: Sweet Khenarthi's Song
166015.description: The rich blues and golds of this tapestry, along with its subject matter, might just tempt you into hanging it opposite your bed, allowing it to be the first thing you see in the morning and last thing you see at night.

166016.name: Ice Statue, Cowering Wretch
166016.description: Oh, the ignominy! To be transformed into ice while hiding in fear along the Frozen Coast! And yet, that's exactly what happened to this unfortunate soul.

166017.name: Witch Pike, Quiescent
166017.description: This odd bundle of sticks, vines, and witch magic looks inert—even safely impressive—but is it?

166018.name: Doll, Heiruna
166018.description: This doll vaguely resembles a character from a popular Nord children's story, and it seeks a new home. Will you cuddle her?

166019.name: Replica Throne of Windhelm
166019.description: Enthrone yourself like a mighty Nord with this faithful replica of the stone throne of Jorunn the Skald-King! Wisdom suggests that you shouldn't irk the High King by trying to claim his title as well.

166020.name: Greymoor Keep Banner, Hanging
166020.description: A dramatic banner representing Greymoor Keep in Blackreach, that most fabled of places.

166021.name: Karthwatch Banner, Hanging
166021.description: With its knotwork tower, the gray banner of Karthwatch symbolizes the bravery and steadfastness of the Nords who live there.

166022.name: Morthal Banner, Hanging
166022.description: Morthal's banner features a white triskelion on a field of gray reminiscent of its misty marshes. Whether the triskelion symbolizes the unity of the mind, body, and spirit—or something else entirely—serves as the subject of scholarly debates.

166023.name: Solitude Banner, Hanging
166023.description: Throughout Solitude's long history, it has been watched over by the wolves on its banners. Legends claim that so long as one wolf flies on the ramparts of Solitude, Mara's protective embrace will grace the city's walls.

166024.name: Kyne's Aegis Banner, Hanging
166024.description: The Mother of Nords watches over those who display this colorful banner of the Hawk Ascendant—or so popular Nord sentiment claims!

166025.name: Nord Basket Trap, Fishing
166025.description: Though once used primarily by Nords in Western Skyrim, baskets such as this one catch fish well outside the Sea of Ghosts now.

166026.name: Nord Boat, Fishing
166026.description: Complete with netting and sails, this Nord fishing boat is a common sight on the Sea of Ghosts. Though many of those fisherfolk catch more than they bargained for in those treacherous waters, or so the stories tell.

166434.description: Bask in the beauty and grandeur of Cyrodiil and the Imperial City, unmarred by the Three Banners War.

166435.name: Seat of the Snow Prince
166435.description: The simple lines of this stone throne offer some insight into the personality of the Snow Elf ruler who ordered its creation.

166436.name: Tusks of the Orc-Father
166436.description: None who see these imposing tusks from Wrothgar on your estate can doubt your bravery. Having them is one thing. Keeping them? Another entirely.

166463.description: From impressive heights to treacherous waters, the lands of Western Skyrim depicted on this map show almost invisible political boundaries as well—almost. Someone tried to hide them by mimicking the artistry of the original cartographer.

166471.name: Tall Papa's Lamp
166471.description: The incense burned within this marvelous lamp is alleged to have guided Yokudans into transcendent experiences.

166472.name: Morwha's Blessing
166472.description: The four-armed Yokudan fertility goddess Morwha stands enshrined and flanked by her winged guardians, promising prosperity to all who stand before her.

166473.name: Greensong Gathering Circle
166473.description: With this cauldron, you can gather companions to honor the Green or simply display it as an interesting Wood Elf creation.

166474.name: Altar of Celestial Convergence
166474.description: What occurs when the stars align to match the constellation at the heart of this ominous altar remains a mystery, but the sinister serpents on display conjure only catastrophe in the imagination.

171387.name: Nighthollow Banner

171388.name: Dwarven Tonal Cascade
171388.description: "Dwemer devices are precise instruments. Usually. This, however, appears to emit tonal forces in a torrent. Catastrophically dangerous. Never turn it on. If there were a control mechanism, maybe, but I can't fathom what could tune it."—Neramo

171389.name: Dwarven Crystal Receptacle
171389.description: Though its pronged receptacle stands empty, this pillar once housed some form of Dwarven stone or crystal.

171390.name: Reachwitch Protective Totem
171390.description: This totem sees use only in places where Reach clans intend to set up camp for more than a few weeks or around Markarth. Some witches claim that subversive uses for this totem abound among bloodthirstier clans.

171391.name: Reach Effigy of Turnabout
171391.description: The bones, twigs, and hide that make up this effigy all receive blood-blessings from the clan's witchfolk, who claim it sends spirits with ill intentions back to plague their erstwhile masters.

171392.name: Falmer Totem of Dominance
171392.description: "I would ask the scholar who wrote 'I discovered Falmer mark their territory with such totems' more about this ill-scented column and these Falmer she mentions, but she died after penning this entry in her journal. How inconvenient."—Scholar Tuintaatel

171393.name: Tree, Reach Totem
171393.description: "Above us, the limbs stretch to the sky. Below us, the roots spread throughout the ground. Where both meet in this tree, place your bone offerings. Renew them with oils after every rain or the tree's spirit will seek your doom."—Reachwitch Eoinellgen

171394.name: Dwarven Stand, Void Crystal
171394.description: "Admittedly, I do love shiny things—perhaps too much given my time spent, ahem, among guards shall we say—but something about this stone makes me feel ill at ease. What were those barmy Dwarves up to with this?"—Gorthuth, Dwarven Ruins Delver

171395.name: Dwarven Beacon, Aetheric
171395.description: "By Dagon's fiery arse, the aetheric stones in this Dwarven device simply will not budge. What are they for? Don't care. But by Zen, I can't lug this entire piece of metal out of here right now. Feh."—Gorthuth, Dwarven Ruins Delver

171396.name: Dwarven Tonal Manacle
171396.description: "This Dwarven gewgaw tethers … something. Trust me, I know plenty about tethers. Can smell 'em on a guard at more than fifty paces away, and this thing reeks of tethers…manacles…that sort of thing. Let's avoid it."—Gorthuth, Dwarven Ruins Delver

171429.name: Red Eagle Cave Painting
171429.description: Though this cave painting stands tall, the legend of Red Eagle stands taller still among those living in the Reach … and beyond. The visceral impact of this piece may just haunt your dreams.

171431.name: Antique Map of the Reach
171431.description: Reachfolk have little use for maps, knowing the land as well as they know their own bodies, so an intrepid explorer must have drafted this cartographic wonder—perfect for hanging on your wall or planning your next Reach excursion.

171542.name: Music Box, Farewell to Nenalata

171543.name: Music Box, Feast of All Flames

171544.name: Comet, Aetherial
171544.description: "I can only speculate why the Ayleids sought to recreate the effect of a shooting star passing through the night sky. I set up a few in my garden to my guests' delight, after putting aside some for further study."—Mage Uryacil

171545.name: Ayleid Gate, Large
171545.description: Often found within Ayleid ruins, these large gates provide an elegant barrier between rooms. Whether they keep something in or out is entirely up to you.

171546.name: Ayleid Relief, Blessed Life-Tree
171546.description: "Each time I see the Ayleid life-tree, my heart beats faster. What treasure—what knowledge—lies deep beneath its roots? I put this relief in my home so I never forget that exhilaration!"—Theldyn Faden, Explorer

171601.name: Replica Jubilee Cake 2021
171601.description: Chef Donolon's Jubilee Cake is the perfect pastry to celebrate any special occasion or awesome anniversary. Relish its luscious flavor—tantalizing to your taste buds!

175700.name: Deadlands Chandelier, Caged
175700.description: Daedric flames burn within these ornate, caged sconces. The light they grant may seem harmless enough, but the fires of Oblivion often cast darkness upon the soul.

175701.name: Xi-Tsei Stone Idol
175701.description: Though no blood or moss mars this Argonian idol, similar symbols decorate the infamous Xi-Tsei xanmeer where the Fourth Imperial Legion met its end in 1E 2820. Did this particular stone guardian watch over the legion's bloody massacre? Who can say?

175702.name: Entwined Snakes, Crystal Holder
175702.description: An ancient Argonian artisan captured this endless struggle between fang-baring serpents, crafting a stone dance of poison and fang that can hold a crystalline light. The jaws of these snakes gape open, ready to hold another light source of your choice.

175703.name: Banner, Tattered Mehrunes Dagon
175703.description: Every ambitious soul needs grit to prevail—so it's fitting that grit worked its way deep into the fabric of this well-worn blood-red banner of the Razor Prince!

175704.name: Inert Oblivion Gate
175704.description: This foreboding structure once held the promise of entry to Oblivion, though now it stands curiously silent. Or does it?

175705.name: Deadlands Pillar, Tall Inscribed
175705.description: With its eerie crimson markings, this carved pillar brings the weighty and sometimes malice-laden presence of the Daedra to any area it dominates.

175706.name: Seal of the Ambitions
175706.description: This seal represents the vessels of Dagon's power, known as the Ambitions. May its commanding gaze serve as a reminder of all you accomplished against the Prince of Cataclysm!

175707.name: Banner of Leyawiin
175707.description: The spring green and glinting gold of Leyawiin's banner provide the perfect backdrop for the city's proud, equine emblem. Long may the White Stallion ride!

175708.name: Deadlands Tormentor, Chained
175708.description: Some say chains make for the best captive audience, and the ones on this Daedric-tested device of torment promise to keep your guests secure—and fettered.

175709.name: Deadlands Podium of Ruination
175709.description: Even the most delicate verse can take on an air of menace when you place it—preferably in weighty tome form—upon this imposing podium.

182302.name: Daedric Enchanting Station
182302.description: Who knows what vile enchantments took shape on this Daedric worktable? Perhaps you can craft something even darker. When placed in your home, this crafting station allows you to craft Enchantment items.

182303.name: Dagon's Scalding Gibbet
182303.description: Fear is a tool best used in moderation, but when you must turn to it, be ready with the appropriate accessories. This torture device, for instance—even looking at it may cause some to spill their secrets.

182304.name: Tree, Charred Dagonic
182304.description: How this skeleton of a burned tree once grew here remains a mystery.

182305.name: Deadlands Window, Stormglass
182305.description: While most associate Deadlands architecture with fiery reds, the deep blues of a churning sea are no less intimidating. Let the cold light of a rising flood wash over you when standing before this Daedric window.

182306.name: Daedric Altar, Mehrunes Dagon
182306.description: No place of worship dedicated to the Prince of Destruction can be called such without this altar. If you can't please Mehrunes Dagon, best make sure you don't anger him by lacking this centerpiece.

182307.name: Deadlands Lightning Rod, Etched
182307.description: If you dare to live among the storms of the Sever, be sure to place plenty of lightning rods around. The fact that these might scare off cowardly mortals is a welcome perk.

182308.name: Deadlands Wind Gate Pinion
182308.description: This majestic stone structure draws the gaze even as it dominates the landscape. Perfect as a focal piece in your courtyard or bit of Oblivion.

182309.name: Deadlands Buttress, Large
182309.description: Decorate and support your walls in Daedric style with this towering buttress. While it won't stop Dagon himself from entering your abode if he wishes, lesser beings might reconsider any plans to besiege your residence.

182310.name: Deadlands Buttress

197700.name: Apocrypha Fossil, Bones Large
197700.description: Though you may not ever find out what creature these bones belong to, they're a must-have for any ossuary garden or, if you're more traditional in your reliquiae displays, fossil collection.

197701.name: Apocrypha Fossil, Nautilus
197701.description: Lovers of large fossils, rejoice! This enormous nautilus fossil can serve as the backdrop for your next outdoor gathering.

197702.name: Apocrypha Fossil, Worm
197702.description: Faithful of Mora believe that the fossils embedded across the realm of Apocrypha are remnants of another place, another realm, the origin point of the Daedric Prince of Knowledge. Certainly, they correspond to no creatures native to Tamriel.

197703.name: Apocrypha Fossil, Arch
197703.description: This arching fossil may have once belonged to a gigantic creature of Apocrypha, but now it can serve as an archway within your home.

197705.name: Telvanni Alchemy Station
197705.description: With components inspired by a variety of cultures, this alchemy station not only helps you mix all manner of ingredients into useful potions, but also adds a touch of all things Tamriel to your home.

197706.name: Trifold Mirror of Alternatives
197706.description: "May your wardrobe reflect the dark sophistication of this mirror trio. It's not my style, but when I look deeply into your eyes, I think it suits you more than you may think."—Fairwen of Vulkhel Guard

197707.name: Apocryphal Well
197707.description: The liquid in this well never stills and resembles a roiling portal to the realm of Hermaeus Mora.

197708.name: Cliff Strider Skeleton Stand
197708.description: Set up this experiment in taxidermy and Cliff Strider anatomy in your home—just make sure to warn any guests about it before they enter its space. It's a bit … startling.

197709.name: Tribunal Window, Stained Glass
197709.description: Bring the light of the Tribunal into your home with this stained glass window. Featuring rich colors, this sacred art piece can serve as the focal point of your personal shrine to ALMSIVI.

197710.name: Mushroom Classification Book
197710.description: Flip through the illustrated pages of this Telvanni library staple. While it may not share the deep knowledge that mycoturges possess, it can serve as an entertaining conversation starter at your next gathering.

197711.name: Antique Map of the Telvanni Peninsula
197711.description: The fine detail work on the coastlines contrasts strongly with inland portions of the map. Almost as if House Telvanni had little interest in a truly accurate depiction of the peninsula.

197712.name: Antique Map of Apocrypha
197712.description: "Mapping Apocrypha and expecting the result to help anyone else is foolish. Instead consider the map to be more of a visual guide to the cartographer's experiences there—unique to them alone."—Excerpt from an unknown Cipher's Journal

197713.name: Tribunal Rug
197713.description: This is a standard house item.

197715.name: Necrom Stele, Ceremonial
197715.description: Raised only to venerate ancestors that have shaped the very fabric of a family line. Ensure your forbearers are pleased by making this classic stele the focal piece of your own shrine.

197716.name: Crystalline Mind Barrier, Replica
197716.description: Replicated painstakingly via rough description by the very few that have returned from the nightmare realms of Vaermina, this barrier is a reminder of a dark and challenging mind-realm far from the light of day.

197717.name: Apocrypha Altar, Lighted
197717.description: Some scholars of Apocrypha claim that if you meditate at one of its altars, a stray piece of lost knowledge may find its way into your mind. Will this work in your home? Probably not, but you'd look suitably impressive while meditating.

197718.name: Necrom Archway
197718.description: Accents of green on white stone decorate this solid archway. Anything beyond it must surely be worth seeing given its elegantly dramatic appearance.

197719.name: Apocrypha Courtyard Pool
197719.description: The visions one could scry within the pools of Apocrypha sometimes cause a viewer's mind to shatter. Thankfully for you, this particular pool looks stunning, but provides no mind-breaking visions.

197720.name: Hermaeus Mora Banner
197720.description: No one can entertain doubts as to your affiliation when you hang this banner featuring the Golden Eye's symbols in your home.

197721.name: The Lord of Fate and Knowledge Frieze
197721.description: Place this frieze of the Keeper of Forbidden Knowledge in a prominent place. Perhaps the One Who Knows will look upon you with favor and share some curious bit of information when you most need it. Or, perhaps not.

197722.name: Apocrypha Portal Seal, Replica
197722.description: If this were a real portal seal in your abode, you may end up questioning your life choices. As it stands, this replica serves as a marvelous accent in any space.

197723.name: Apocrypha Stalk, Scryeball
197723.description: Feel as if you're being watched? With these bizarre stalks around, you are. Each stalk adds an element of oddball ambience to wherever you choose to plant it.

197724.name: Tales of Tribute Kit, Travel
197724.description: A testament to the increasing popularity of this Roister's club favorite, this travel kit shows your love of Tales of Tribute to all and sundry that visit your home.

197725.name: Replica Fateweaver Key
197725.description: A recreation by Azandar al-Cybiades to honor the research adventure of a lifetime.

197726.name: Dormant Tyranite Calx
197726.description: This broken, brittle shard of tyranite calx is empty of magic and cool to the touch. Should the metal's dormancy ever change, you will be the first to know.

204418.description: A relic of Sanguine worship in Colovia, this piece combines the love of weald wines and Daedric worship in one small package.

204419.name: Ayleid Sculpture, Grand Tree
204419.description: Whether a sign of ancient magics now unmoored or intentional aesthetics, the magicka mist around this statue is another sign of the Ayleid mastery of magic.

204420.name: Ayleid Blacksmithing Station
204420.description: The wisdom, power, and magic of the Heartland Elves still lingers about this potent crafting station. What will you forge?

204424.name: Antique Map of West Weald
204424.description: "Once you lose sight of the coast, you start to walk the weald. It goes on and on, well out of sight, with only the road cut through the trees a marker to chart your course." - Phrastus of Elinhir

204618.name: Ayleid Arch, Wide
204618.description: The Heartland Elves saw arches as doors not just from outside to in, from room to room, but as symbols of change and transition. Part of a strong tradition to revere travel and pathfinding with near religious reverence.

204619.name: Ayleid Window, Large
204619.description: What wonders did this relic once look out upon? What wonders will it see now that its in your care?

204620.name: Ayleid Sculpture, Simple Tree
204620.description: A surprisingly complex structure for one with such a simple (and beautiful) history.

204621.name: Ayleid Sculpture, Complex Tree
204621.description: A beautiful sculpture hinting at shades of magical and religious symbology from the base of the trunks to the tips of the branches.

204622.name: Ayleid Lens Array, Reassembled
204622.description: The Ayleid people knew how to focus magic in a way few still understand. These relics of the past speak to that heritage, to that promise.

204623.name: Colovian Tapestry, Worn
204623.description: The rich blue dyes featured on this tapestry come from over the border in Hammerfell, commemorating the centuries-long trade relationship between that region and Colovia.

204624.name: Colovian Tapestry, Pastoral Farm
204624.description: The fertile ground of West Weald is ideal for all kinds of planting and growing. Its art speaks to this tradition, and this strength.

204625.name: Colovian Tapestry, Fancy Gate
204625.description: A faded holdover from a more prosperous time in the Empire's past.

204779.description: The true Portal to the Loom of the Untraveled Road remains elusive to the average adventurer, but you saw it yourself. Remind yourself that which so few remember by placing this replica in your home.

204780.name: Fable of the Dragon
204780.description: A beautiful replica of the Fable of the Dragon, taken from the shelves of the Scholarium beneath Eyevea.

204781.name: Skingrad Banner, Small
204781.description: Share your love of Skingrad, home to high-quality wines and cheeses, by hanging this small banner within your home.

204782.name: Fable of the Gryphon

204785.name: Recollection Camp Sign, Sprouted
204785.description: Even the signs of the Recollection burst with life. Thankfully this one won't do more than provide a colorful bit of greenery to your home.

204786.name: Lucent Throne, Replica
204786.description: "Ah, this throne pokes at my curiosity. A replica, certainly. Yet the original comes from obscurity. Perhaps you'll discover its provenance?"—Gathareth of Skingrad

204787.name: Colovian Lamppost, Overgrown
204787.description: The sturdy Colovian design of this post seems to have defeated the plant's attempts at crushing it … for now.

204788.name: Colovian Cheese Press, Large
204788.description: Cheese presses are a common enough sight in Colovian homes. This large one allows artisans to press wheels large enough for feasts!

204789.name: Ayleid Stele, Tall
204789.description: The intricate designs of this Ayleid stele provide an insight into the importance they placed on beauty and grace in their architecture.

204790.name: Fable of the Netch
204790.description: A beautiful replica of the Fable of the Netch, taken from the shelves of the Scholarium beneath Eyevea.

204791.name: Sapling, Dawnwood Growth
204791.description: The greenery of the Dawnwood may grow quickly, but it still goes through all the normal phases of plant life, as evidenced by this sapling.

204792.name: Table, Visions of the Five Companions
204792.description: The unique design of this large table allowed the Five Companions to plan, debate, and share information before setting out on their next adventure. Perhaps some memories of past days linger, waiting for you to watch?

204793.name: Scholarium Column, Large
204793.description: Constellations mark even the columns of the Scholarium, adding visual interest to what would otherwise be a mere structural support component.

204794.name: Null Arca, Replica
204794.description: This replica of the Null Arca may not actually contain and stabilize the Arcane Knot, but it adds a sense of wonder to your living space.

204795.name: Scholarium Door, Dragon
204795.description: A statue of the Luminary Dragon perches over this Scholarium door as if watching the proceedings in the room.

204796.name: Scholarium Door, Gryphon
204796.description: The imperious glare of the Luminary Gryphon makes the creature seem almost lifelike.

204797.name: Scholarium Door, Indrik
204797.description: The splendid Luminary Indrik statue strikes a proud pose over this Scholarium door.

204798.name: Mirror of Truth, Replica
204798.description: The cracks in this ornate mirror remind many of something they can't quite recollect. And you dare not tell them.

214355.name: Solstice Giant Crocodile Skull
214355.description: Among the Argonians of Solstice, the crocodile was seen as a guardian of the Unmaker, Sithis. This skull belonged to an enormous beast, likely reared by worshippers of the Dread Father to guard one of his temples.

214356.name: Solstice Giant Crocodile Ribs
214356.description: Among the Argonians of Solstice, the crocodile was seen as a guardian of the Unmaker, Sithis.  Ribs like these have been found in ancient ceremony sites dedicated to the Death-Dancer sect, a void-dwelling tradition dating back centuries.

214357.name: Solstice Giant Crocodile Tail
214357.description: Among the Argonians of Solstice, the crocodile was seen as a guardian of the Unmaker, Sithis. Enormous beasts like this once acted as mounts for Stone-Nest assassins in their ancient conflict with Coldharbour.

214358.name: Large Solstice Bismuth Tower
214358.description: An artifact of the incredible Stone-Nest Argonian culture. These ornamental towers once marked future locations for Xanmeers or temple support buildings, a discipline now lost to the artisans of today.

214359.name: Geometric Stone-Nest Totem
214359.description: An artifact of the incredible Stone-Nest Argonian culture. These simple totems were once wayfinders to sacred structures across Solstice. They have been moved so many times that it's impossible tell what they were originally pointing to.

214360.name: Stone-Nest Totem, Iguana
214360.description: An artifact of the incredible Stone-Nest Argonian culture. A representation of a simple lizard may seem ironic in a culture of lizard-folk, but these beasts were seen as sacred animals in the distant past.

214361.name: Stone-Nest Totem, Behemoth
214361.description: An artifact of the incredible Stone-Nest Argonian culture. Most likely an ancient representation of the dangerous Vahath Behemoth, a guardian beast created in the days of myth and legend.

214362.name: Stone-Nest Totem, Massive Skull
214362.description: An artifact of the incredible Stone-Nest Argonian culture. The skull of Sithis wears many shapes and has been worked into stone in a hundred different ways.
