12786.description: What it lacks in flight, it makes up for in fight! One lunge and its prey is paralyzed with poison, which gives it enough time to eat and hop away like a normal frog.

12787.name: War Veteran's Hunting Dog
12787.description: "I love hunting with my dogs, but I can't understand why they try to pull my boots off after each hunt. Maybe it's a quirk of the breed?"—Ushataga

12802.name: Law of Julianos Dwarven Spider
12802.description: "Dwemer design married to the unyielding logic of Julianos. One of my finest creations. The first of this design was personally delivered to my patron in Wayrest, along with a fabulous bottle of wine."—The personal notes of the Spidersmith

12804.name: Jerall Deserter's Tharriker
12804.description: War deserters that huddle for warmth around bitter campfires in the Jerall mountains found common cause with these wild tharrikers. The wild magic that created them allows for rapid adaptation to the snowy slopes of their new home.

12963.name: Timber Mammoth
12963.description: "Behold the mammoth. Bred among the majestic trees of Malabal Tor. Let its strength endow you with courage and its even-tempered persistence carry you safely. And let its beauty uplift your soul."—Overheard at the Baandari Trading Post

12964.name: Bust: Lord Hollowjack
12964.description: This is a standard house collectible.

12965.name: Barbas
12965.description: Barbas, Clavicus Vile's faithful companion, loves being a talking dog. Why he wants to stay with you is for him to know and you to never find out. After adding Barbas to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.

12966.name: Narsis Dren
12966.description: Self-proclaimed expert adventurer and prolific author Narsis Dren needs some time away from his exploits to write his next thrilling book. After adding Narsis to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.

12967.name: Trophy: Lord Hollowjack
12967.description: This is a standard house collectible.

12968.name: Scaleborn Wolf
12968.description: "Honestly , it was pleasure just to work with someone outside the House. Please give my warmest regards to Queen Khamira, and I will take her up on her offer of hospitality the next time I'm in Rimmen."—Magister Varkenel

12969.name: Scaleborn Senche-Raht
12969.description: "We've received the scavenged material and the specifications for the product line. This is all very doable, but will likely be somewhat expensive given the properties of draconic fleshweave."—Magister Varkenel

12970.name: Scaleborn Ram
12970.description: "I think it's a wonderful idea, and the time table is completely workable. You should see your friends in the Dragonguard astride these beasts within the year."—Magister Varkenel

12971.name: Scaleborn Bear
12971.description: "If you're looking for a suggestion for the fourth form, might I suggest something like a bear? I know these mighty beasts are not local to your region but it's proven a popular shape in other work I've done."—Magister Varkenel

12972.name: Stone-Nest Landloper
12972.description: "Some customs of Solstice's Stone-Nest tribe date back well beyond Duskfall. The magical processes they used to shape flesh as they do stone is lost to the modern villagers, but lives on in ancient designs."—Muzah-Tei, Stone-Nest Scribbles

12973.name: Kyne-Blessed Thundersnow Steed
12973.description: These mounts are consecrated when they're only colts, given over in a ceremony to the Storm Goddess. Their riders say you can feel a distant rumble of thunder with every stride.

12974.name: Coldharbour Death Hound
12974.description: Molag Bal's domain is patrolled by vampiric hounds. Wrapped in the mists of Coldharbour, bones erupting from flesh, it strikes fear into the hearts of others, and sometimes the hearts of their riders as well.
12974.hint: Acquired by completing the "Savior of Solstice" achievement.

12975.name: Gloam Senche
12975.description: A native of the Nocturnal's domain, Evergloam, these ghost cats are known to escape their bonds and roam Tamriel at will. They choose only the most fortunate (or most unfortunate) to serve as their masters, who need a strong hand at the reins.

12976.name: Twilight Kagouti Destroyer
12976.description: This beast's black, scarred hide shows it to be the victor of many battles. Its fierce eyes declare that it has only recently been domesticated. Ride at your own risk.

12977.name: Golden Nix-Ox Steed
12977.description: The gilded shells of these creatures glow in even the weakest ashfall sunlight. Golden nix-oxen are prized both by merchants seeking to display their prosperity and by worshipers of Akatosh for their beauty.

12978.name: Gloam Senche Cub
12978.description: "As I sat by the fire, I felt two little eyes glaring at me in the darkness. I left some meat at the edge of camp and was shocked when a ghostly senche came out and nibbled on it. Maybe Nocturnal answered my prayer."—Recovered journal of Felisa Moabenar

12979.name: Heart's Grief Welwa
12979.description: War mounts created to patrol the far reaches of Coldharbour, these dread beasts have been unleashed on Tamriel. Their hearts are dark with malice, and they live only to witness the destruction of others.
12979.hint: Acquired by completing the "Worth the Pain" Achievement.

12980.name: Solstice Flats Dovah-Fly
12980.description: Isolation from the rest of Tamriel for generations has caused the local dovah-fly population to develop bright, unusual colors. They seem to be a warning to predators, although the Solstice dovah-fly itself isn't poisonous.

12981.name: Navire Chicken
12981.description: "It may not look like much, but this chicken is lucky, I swear. It's always finding little snacks for me, like apples or an old loaf of bread. It's like it doesn't want me to be hungry. Isn't that nice?"—Farmer Quentyn

12982.name: Twilight Kagouti Hatchling
12982.description: Though unruly, Twilight Kagouti Hatchlings can make excellent hunters—if their unfocused energy can ever be harnessed. Many a training session has been unexpectedly ended when a hatchling caught scent of some small animal and disappeared into the bushes.

12983.name: Golden Shalk
12983.description: An Ashlander tale says that one in every thousand clutches of shalk eggs is specially blessed by the ancestors. The existence of golden shalks seems to support this belief, but no one has ever seen one hatch before.

12984.name: Honeybutter Dragon Frog
12984.description: "I demand a refund on this dragon frog, Nahafa! All it does is scorch my things, bite my fingers, and make rude noises when I have guests. When you said it was a 'honeybutter' variety, I thought it would be sweet!"—Overheard at the Sentinel market

12991.name: Dragonclash Living Armor Senche
12991.description: Forged beneath the hammer blows of master Nord smiths, this living armor provides both speed and warmth. Its overlapping plates move with a supple and tireless grace, fueled by the flames within.

12992.name: Akatosh Living Armor Senche
12992.description: "All hail Akatosh! Golden one! Most resplendent! Let your flames glow bright within this creation! Let it spread your light and lead all to wisdom. Let Akatosh's power live within this wondrous creature!"—Dedication Ceremony
12992.hint: After acquiring other collectibles from the Akatosh vs. Alduin Crown Crate, you can claim this mount.

12993.name: Alduin Living Armor Senche
12993.description: "All-praise to Ald! World-Eater! First of Dragons! Let there be fire in this creature's belly and rage in its visage! Let its fury be felt by those who oppose us! Let Alduin fuel the power of this beast!"—Dedication Ceremony
12993.hint: After acquiring other collectibles from the Akatosh vs. Alduin Crown Crate, you can claim this mount.

12994.name: Tenmar Magpie
12994.description: Brilliant hues mark this vibrant magpie, whose primary habitat lies within the Tenmar Forest. Locals sometimes train them to signal the location of fallen prey for easier retrieval.

12995.name: Lilmoth Crocodile Hatchling
12995.description: Many of these hatchlings come from western Murkmire. Raised by the Dead-Water tribe to appear strong and spark fear, some secretly find them cute to keep as pets.

13061.name: Evenfall Brekka
13061.description: A great dark-furred creature, this beast holds its head high as if a queen among the herd. Other brekkas follow in the wake of this confident leader even in the harshest of climates.

13062.name: Evenshade Brekka Calf
13062.description: Baby brekkas are known to be affectionate, but this one is especially clingy. It's always within arm's reach, never straying farther than its neck can reach. It seems to take comfort in its owner's presence.

13063.name: Siluruz, Realm Craftsmaster
13063.description: Fresh from their Daedric forge, Craftmaster Siluruz has the talent to see to the heart of the matter, and thereby reduce items to their components. They avoid Cyrodiil or Battlegrounds, as mortal conflict bores them in their search for pure creations.

13066.name: Terilorne, Dibellan Freetrader
13066.description: Terilorne is a footloose merchant who seeks to spread the joy and beauty of Dibella in her wake. She will not enter Cyrodiil or Battlegrounds, as the jarring vibrations of the conflicts there harshes her enjoyment of the world.

13089.name: Statuette: Yokudan War-Scholar
13089.description: Brilliant battlefield tacticians often became venerated heroes among the Yokudan warriors.

13090.name: Statuette: High Elf Mage
13090.description: "Some claim to know the provenance of this sleek piece of art, but they know nothing. Especially when it comes to how impressive your home would be with a replica in it!" —Zaidrashi, Merchant

13091.name: Painting: Lucent Citadel
13091.description: Shrouded in mystery, the Lucent Citadel gleams in the sand of Fargrave's wastelands.

13106.name: Alabaster Vvardvark
13106.description: With the popularity of the vvardvark on the rise, Telvanni magisters are constantly searching for that hit "next look." Just as steadfast as their colorful kin, these beasts make for playful companions as long as they remain mostly indoors.

13107.name: Dragonclash Tomeshell
13107.description: "It was a stunning tome. Gorgeously detailed and filled with tales of esoteric Nord mythology. Supple leather binding, gold leaf on the cover … and now it's host for a transliminal parasite!"—Cipher Volan

13108.name: Windhelm Snow Owl
13108.description: "The sound of snapped bones led me back to my trap. A snow owl was eating my kill! So bold, I wasn't even mad. The next day we began our training, and we've been together ever since."—A Mountain Tale by Tharyt the Trapper

13109.name: Ghostwhite Vvardvark
13109.description: The magisters of House Telvanni are constantly working to perfect their craft and make some coin. This pallid beast is a trendy fashion statement for the next time you turn up at the inn.

13110.name: Leafember Ursauk
13110.description: "The fury of the druids could not be sated. As sparks fell around me and the forest burned, it appeared from beyond a curtain of smoke. Marked by the destruction. But still loyal."—Y'ffelon eruption survivor's tale

13116.name: Trappers Peak Wolf Cub
13116.description: These striking wolves are native to Amenos, where their ululating howls echo through the forest. The cubs don't yet have their calls perfected, but that doesn't stop them from trying to make themselves heard.

13117.name: Trappers Peak Wolf
13117.description: You'll not find a more dedicated and loyal mount. They bond closely with their masters, as long as they are properly fed, cared for, and get frequent tummy rubs.

13263.name: Daenian Great Ram
13263.description: The great rams of the Daenian birch forests tend to be shy and skittish. Yet, if properly trained, they can be exquisite and powerful mounts.

13265.name: Duo-Dynamo Guardian Spider
13265.description: Constructed of refurbished Dwarven parts within a fully reconditioned housing, the Duo-Dynamo is the perfect mount for a comfortable, sharable ride.

13271.name: Za'ji
13271.description: Captain Za'ji of the Perfect Pounce sails the seas from Elsweyr to High Isle. Now, though, he hopes to bunk with you while his ship is being refit. After adding Za'ji to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.

13274.name: Ruinous Bone Dragon
13274.description: It goes without saying that bone Dragons of this size don't naturally exist. The necromancer that crafted this construct must have done so with utmost care. Even at this scale, the Dragon exudes an intimidating energy.

13286.name: Solstice Sloth
13286.description: The sloths of Solstice have long been favored pets of Sunport residents, especially children. It's not uncommon for teachers to perform "sloth checks" to make sure enterprising students aren't attempting to use their bags to smuggle sloths into lessons.
13286.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "The Gift of Death" in Solstice.

13292.name: Plaguewater Swamp Skeever
13292.description: "The first time I saw this skeever at my doorstep, I praised Peryite. Then prostrated myself, as this steed warrants. I'd been called into the world from my cave hideaway. Now we share my Prince's blessings wherever we travel."—Plague Elder Anai No-Nose

13293.name: Dreadmare of a Thousand Truths
13293.description: "Servants who earn Vaermina's trust may be gifted this loyal dreadmare. Their first ride from Quagmire takes them on an eldritch path, as the hands of the beast painfully claw out every flaw along the way."—Excerpted from "Paths Through the Mire"

13468.name: Aswala Scorpion
13468.description: "If your horse spares a red-tailed scorpion from being crushed underfoot, the scorpion was sent by the First Serpent to share your camp. To keep it free from vermin."—From Grandee Yaghoub's writings

13469.name: Dreamharrow Wasp
13469.description: Quagmire wasps build nests with nightmares as wasps of Nirn build nests with pulp. Distressing. Yet, you may find having one around useful. Especially when a Daedric Prince seeks to disturb your dreamwalks.

13470.name: Anequina Ginger Cat
13470.description: This adorable ginger cat has more purrs than you can count. He longs to be out and about, whether it's on an adventure or watching you craft potential kitty toys.

13471.name: Pestilent Pony Guar
13471.description: A colorful little friend happy to follow you into even the most disease-ridden dens. Many find the smell off-putting? But this true soul of Peryite goes snout-first into pestilence with a grin.

13472.name: Mara's Glory Wolf Pup
13472.description: "When times are tough and compassion grows thin, Mother Mara graces us with her wolf pups to remind us to be kind. Not nice, mind you. Nice tries to talk away all the bad. Kind recognizes the bad and seeks to end it."—Acolyte Ylaine

13473.name: Swamp Skeever Pup
13473.description: "Of course our skeever mounts start out as pups! That gives us time to train them properly, as Peryite intends. Just try not to cuddle them to death, got it?"—Yamighu

13491.name: Statuette: Imperial Knight
13491.description: A miniature statue of an Imperial knight, standing proud and ready to serve.

13492.name: Statuette: Redguard Warrior
13492.description: A miniature statue of a Redguard warrior, often used within royal tombs.

13493.name: Painting: Shadowfen Mirescape
13493.description: "You may see a swamp. Ruins. Trees. Water. But I see life and endings. Death and beginnings. And most of all change. Learn from the Shadowfen as I do."—Juutenma, Shadowscale

13494.name: Trophy: Orpheon the Tactician
13494.description: Trophy taken from Orpheon the Tactician in honor of an Undaunted victory in Lep Seclusa.

13495.name: Bust: Orpheon the Tactician
13495.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Lep Seclusa.
13495.hint: Awarded for completing Veteran Lep Seclusa.

13496.name: Trophy: Squall of Retribution
13496.description: Trophy taken from the Squall of Retribution in honor of an Undaunted victory in Exiled Redoubt.

13497.name: Bust: Squall of Retribution
13497.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Exiled Redoubt.
13497.hint: Awarded for completing Veteran Exiled Redoubt.

13498.name: Plaguerot Dragon Imp
13498.description: Rimmen gossips speculate this imp takes the shape of a miniature green Dragon in praise to Peryite, who helped the little beasts escape flu-ridden Orcrest.

13499.name: Soul Gem Senche Cub
13499.description: "This cub represents a strange mix of danger and comfort. I don't think this morpholithic cub can capture souls? But one never knows until one tries."—Afwa's Journal

13500.name: Pestilent Guar
13500.description: "The colors! So bright. Thank Peryite, it doesn't breathe vile fumes. Well, unless you've fed it fungus. Then it has the foulest breath ever. So. Don't feed it fungus."—Yamighu's New-New Journal

13501.name: Soul Gem Senche
13501.description: This beast serves its rider without hesitation. Necromancers claim it hums in dark resonance when near soul gems that were created in Coldharbour.

13504.name: Grimshadow Pillion Moose
13504.description: The inky-black fur of this moose blends into shadows during twilight treks a couple may wish to undertake in secrecy. Since the moose shares no gossip, your secrets remain safe.

13505.name: Wormwrithe Bear-Lizard
13505.description: "The guardians of the Writhing Wall were shaped, warped, and even twisted by the power of the souls contained within. We should care for the beasts and folk touched by the wall. What other choice do right-thinking folk have? "—Captain Meggrid

13506.name: Wormwrithe Haj Mota Hatchling
13506.description: An odd creature first seen near the Writhing Wall, this hatchling exhibits a necromantic contamination that sets it beyond the natural order. It needs a good home, shunned by the other regional wildlife.
13506.hint: Acquired by completing the "Wormwrithe Haj Mota Hatchling" achievement.

13517.name: Celia Tyde, Lost Fleet Bursar
13517.description:
Celia Tyde may be a pirate, but you can trust her to safeguard your valuables in the hold of her Lost Fleet vessel.

Aetheric winds mean you can't summon her in Cyrodiil or on Battlegrounds, though you and your groupmates can use her services.

13518.name: Voko, Carnaval Weapondancer
13518.description: You and your group can prep for sanguine slaughter by summoning Voko to change and save armory builds outside of your home. A lack of wine and dancing disinterests him from offering his services in Cyrodiil or the Battlegrounds.

13521.name: Elsbytte
13521.description: The Nord explorer Elsbytte and her faithful mammoth Muffins roam the wilds of Tamriel in search of adventure. Invite them to stay awhile! After adding them to your home, you can set them on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with Elsbytte.

13534.name: Ash-Tipped Durzog
13534.description: "A friend told me these durzogs came from a magical mishap with an extremely fortunate result. But they're so masterful, how can that be true? Either way, I love mine."—Dragonknight Ellean

13535.name: Blighted Sep Adder
13535.description: "What's worse than a surprise sep adder? A surprise sep adder blighted by Peryite. Unless? You tame it. Then you've got a friend for life sure to keep biting insects away. And, you don't need to follow Peryite to benefit."—Daixth

13537.name: Ash-Tipped Durzog Pup
13537.description: Born amidst High Isle's volcanic vents, this pup somehow looks both dangerous and cute. But don't let it lull you into complacency! It can burn through a slipper in two breaths if it gets too excited.

13538.name: Mind-Shriven Reef Viper
13538.description: Members of Legion Zero tuck their ophidian friends into a pack in anticipation of their dark blessing. Once they let the snake taste the Blood of Coldharbour, they create an undying mind-shriven companion.

13543.name: Mara's Glory Wolf
13543.description: Worshipers on pilgrimage in Mara's name may—rarely—wake to find one of her favored wolf steeds awaiting them. A not-so-gentle nudge from the Divine Mother.

13544.name: Nightmare Alchemy Vvardvark
13544.description: Fungal spores from the Telvanni Peninsula, when placed in a medium of Quagmire soil and mixed with Pits minerals, grow into a pungent slime. Both rider and beast, after imbibing, travel through a mix of the waking world and dream world.

13545.name: Nightmare Alchemy Senche
13545.description: Cult alchemists in Rimmen distill Tenmar plants watered from the Pits and grown in Dreamstride soil. A few drops from the resulting tincture for both rider and steed bless their missions for Peryite and Vaermina.

13546.name: Nightmare Alchemy Elk
13546.description: Cult priests form a compound with Blackwood herbs and bone salvaged from Quagmire and the Pits. The glowing solution guides this elk and its rider to Prince-favored destinations.

13547.name: Nightmare Alchemy Tharriker
13547.description: A mix of Skingrad wine, some ashy remnants of Quagmire dreams, and ooze from a Pits-born plague hopper make for a heady solution. After imbibing, neither rider or steed can waver from goals set by the Nightmare Queen and the Master of Tasks.

13549.name: Hollowsteel Construct Bear
13549.description: "When good Neramo proposed a line of constructs, Fazudah searched the face of the moons. Then inspiration struck. This one adores Orsinium metalwork! And we have sturdy Wrothgar steel blended with Elsweyri design! And who does not like a bear?"—Fazudah

13550.name: Hollowsteel Construct Wolf
13550.description: "This one would have preferred a senche, but good Neramo just loves the wolf. Still rather elegant she thinks, perfect for a beautiful ride through the countryside. Though Fazudah herself isn't much for riding. She prefers her studio."—Fazudah

13551.name: Hollowsteel Construct Indrik
13551.description: "We could have made anything, of course, but the indrik? Ahh, so sleek. Dreams and whimsy, made from metal! It looks cold, but good Neramo made it as loving as any real indrik. And you don't have to feed it."—Fazudah

13552.name: Duo-Dynamo Hollowsteel Spider
13552.description: "Good Neramo studied with the Spidersmith. So a many-legged multi-rider construct seemed a perfect choice: Dwarven chassis meets the design of mages and Khajiit, spun up in Orsinium steel. What would the Dwemer think if they could see it now?"—Fazudah

13554.name: Furnishing Vault
13554.description:
|cFFFFFF500 Slots|r

You can add the Furnishing Vault to multiple homes, plus retain access to stored items even if the vault isn't placed. Use either the placed vault or the Editor menu to retrieve, place, or store items. The vault holds furnishings only.

13555.name: Duchess Elea Dufort
13555.description: With her grand tour under way, Duchess Elea Dufort hopes to see more of the world beyond High Isle and the Systres Archipelago. Have her visit you! After adding Elea to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.

13571.name: Painting: King's Haven Pass
13571.description: Stories claim High Elves and Goblins once traded peacefully at King's Haven Pass. After relations between the two soured, the Coral-Splitter Goblins claimed the area as their own.

13723.name: Bust: Overfiend Kazpian
13723.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in the Ossein Cage.
13723.hint: Awarded for completing Veteran Ossein Cage.

13724.name: Trophy: Overfiend Kazpian
13724.description: Trophy taken from Overfiend Kazpian in honor of an Undaunted victory in the Ossein Cage.

13725.name: Sea Witch Weather Totem
13725.description: Place this furnishing in your home to call upon the weather magics of the Maormer. The skies above will stay as you wish until you use its power again. Homes without skies are not impacted by its spells.

13726.name: Hew's Bane Hyena
13726.description: When trained from a pup, these hyenas are sought-after battle mounts. Fiercely loyal to their riders, these relentless pursuers possess endless strength and endurance. Two or more together will form a pack and rile each other into a frenzy.

13739.name: Roseblood Bat
13739.description: "Drink deep of his gifts and be blessed for your devotion. For Sanguine cherishes all who embrace his revelry."—Swallow Thy Remedy and Find Peace

13741.name: Illusionist's Torchbug
13741.description: Fledgling mages are known to practice basic illusions on torchbugs, shifting the insect's natural color. In this case it appears someone was a little overzealous with their spellwork.

13742.name: Magmaflow Vvardvark
13742.description: Pulsing with heat, this vvardvark is ideal for the Dark Elf scholar who doesn't mind an occasional burn. Its molten skin allows it to traverse the Ashlands with ease, while its whip-like tongue singes and cooks insects as soon as it catches them.

13743.name: Chalk-White Brekka Calf
13743.description: Though its pale coloring makes this brekka calf look fragile, it's anything but. These small creatures boldly venture away from the herd to confront everything from ash hoppers to desert lions with the same dauntless bravery.

13744.name: Dragonstar Fawn
13744.description: Their affectionate demeanor and sweet tooth make them easy to tame, however they've been known to root up gardens in search of berries and fruit to snack on.

13745.name: Port Telvannis Bantam Guar
13745.description: These furtive bantam guar are particularly skittish. Their mottled coloring helps them blend in with the foliage of Port Telvannis, though their eyes sometimes give them away. They're experts at avoiding predators and would-be pet owners with ease.

13746.name: Honorfeather Fledgling Gryphon
13746.description: "This one had never designed a beast before! But Magister Varkenel was so kind! And Fazudah is quite pleased with how the colors turned out! They are so cuddly, and yet so dangerous. I am obsessed!"—Fazudah, Elsweyr

13747.name: Hew's Bane Hyena Cub
13747.description: The hyenas of Hew's Bane are fiercely loyal and violently territorial, so the taming process must start early. When properly imprinted on their owners, the cubs are eager to please and positively affectionate, though they often nip when overexcited.

13748.name: Chalk-White Brekka
13748.description: Bred to handle high heat and arid environments with ease. Their pale coloring keeps them cool, and wasteland travelers say they need far less water than their pigmented counterparts.

13749.name: Isle of Contemplation Indrik
13749.description: All indriks are ethereal, but this one brings with it a warm breeze and the smell of fresh blossoms. Something about being in its presence makes one want to lie down and doze in the sun, or find a stream in which to swim.

13750.name: Dragonstar Elk
13750.description: From the time they're born, these elk have a strong sweet tooth. This is at odds with their imposing antlers and intimidating appearance, but the Orcs of the Dragontail Mountains use it to their advantage, easily training them with treats and food.

13751.name: Redoran Foyada Vvardvark
13751.description: "It's a warm ride, that's for sure. Don't worry though, the skin isn't actually molten, just very, very hot. The tongue though. Watch out for the tongue."—Mondran Redoran, Ebonheart

13752.name: Forgefire Blade Lion
13752.description: "The result from a decade of collaboration between a forgemaster and a master of Daedric summoning.  A beast of sharp edges, molten veins, daggers for claws and knives for teeth. My life's work."—Forgemaster Gordronak

13756.name: Moonstone Bear Cub
13756.description: "Why wouldn't I turn inanimate moonstone into a cuddly pet construct you can use to light up your library at night? What exactly did you become a mage to do?"—Ohhendel, Sunport Mages Guild

13760.name: Dread Father's Goat
13760.description: "First Creator, Final Destroyer. Void embrace the fallen and felled. Void devour the banished and judged. Void become me so that I may serve your will."—Death-Dancer Recitation

13761.name: Pridehome Jerboa
13761.description: Though all jerboa are fast, these are particularly agile, making them a nightmare to keep track of. Luckily, they have a strong nesting instinct that guides them back home, no matter how far they run.

13762.name: Khenarthi's Thunder Pony
13762.description: "It's a good pet, no? Khenarthi has blessed it with her power, as you can see. Why bless a pony and not a senche? She works in mysterious ways. Just mind the static when you pet it. It gets zappy."—Shikruz, merchant

13763.name: Moonstone Bear
13763.description: This construct's stony body gives it endurance over long rides but, more importantly, the moonstone from which it's constructed is useful for spells. And this bear is more than willing to help.

13789.name: Painting: 10-Year Anniversary
13789.description: So many faces. So many stories. Relive a decade of adventures by picking out your favorite friends from this convivial painting.

13800.name: Trophy: Bar-Sakka
13800.description: Trophy taken from Bar-Sakka in honor of an Undaunted victory in Naj-Caldeesh.

13801.name: Bust: Bar-Sakka
13801.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Veteran Naj-Caldeesh.

13802.name: Trophy: Black Gem Monstrosity
13802.description: Trophy taken from the Black Gem Monstrosity in honor of an Undaunted victory in Black Gem Foundry.
13802.hint: Awarded for completing Black Gem Foundry.

13803.name: Bust: Black Gem Monstrosity
13803.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Veteran Black Gem Foundry.
13803.hint: Awarded for completing Veteran Black Gem Foundry.

13804.name: Statuette: Nereid, Water Singer
13804.description: A miniature statue of a Nereid Water Singer, alight with power.

13805.name: Statuette: Molag Bal, Torturer
13805.description: A miniature statue of the Daedric Prince Molag Bal, Dark Lord of Torture.

13806.name: Painting: Carapace Caverns
13806.description: A painting representing Carapace Caverns, a bismuth-veined cave now plagued by an ancient undead curse.

13824.name: Khenarthi's Thundersteed
13824.description: Swift as the wind, with hoofbeats like thunder and the crackle of lightning in its mane, this strange beast will always be in the eye of the storm with you.

13826.name: Khefrem Spotted Eagle
13826.description: "I don't know how we would've made it through the desert without Azeta. Her sharp eyes and strong wings led us to prey we never knew was there. We followed her cries to a hidden water source that saved our lives."—Journal of hunter Bazdif, Hammerfell

13828.name: Pinnacle of Honor Quasigriff
13828.description: "It was a pleasure to partner with the incomparable Fazudah on beast concepts. The bold choices, the incredible colors. And as she says, I'm confident these creatures will cause a stir wherever they go—the best part of traveling!"—Magister Varkenel

13884.name: Eminent Slothcerer
13884.description: "I'm telling you, it's magic. Really! The hat isn't just for show. Don't look at me that way. Show some respect. It could turn you into a toad for that. It would just take a while, that's all."—Ohhendel, Sunport Mages Guild
13884.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "The Final Dark" in Solstice.

14018.name: Pontius Remus, Lupine Scavenger
14018.description: Pontius made a name for himself getting soldiers to safety when Imperial City fell to the Daedra. Now this survivor has a knack for turning old gear into useful crafting materials. Still, bad memories keep him away from Cyrodiil and the Battlegrounds.

14070.name: Statuette: Roaring Cathay-Raht
14070.description: A miniature statue of a Cathay-Raht roaring at foes.

14071.name: Statuette: Boethiah, Schemer
14071.description: A miniature statue of Boethiah, the Daedric Prince of Cruelty and Torture.

14072.name: Painting: Sunport Approach
14072.description: A painting of Sunport, the capital city of the balmy island of Solstice.

1.name: Discipline Artisan
1.description: Increases experience gain for currently active skills and their skill lines by |cffffff3|r% per stage.

2.name: Out of Sight
2.description: Reduces the radius you can be detected while Sneaking by |cffffff1|r meter per stage.

3.name: Friends in Low Places
3.description:
Removes |cffffff1000|r gold from your bounty once per day when committing a crime where bounty is added.

You must be level 50 for this passive to activate, and your current bounty must be at or greater than |cffffff1000|r gold.

4.name: Fade Away
4.description: Escaping from a Guard wipes |cffffff25|r% of your current Heat, but not Bounty.

5.name: Cutpurse's Art
5.description: Increases the chance to get higher-quality loot when pickpocketing.

6.name: Shadowstrike
6.description: When you kill an enemy with Blade of Woe, you become invisible for |cffffff5|r seconds after a short delay while distracting nearby enemies or potential witnesses. While under this effect you can cast Blade of Woe.

7.name: Master Gatherer
7.description: Reduces the time it takes to harvest by |cffffff10|r% per stage.

8.name: Treasure Hunter
8.description: Increase the quality of items you find in treasure chests.

9.name: Steadfast Enchantment
9.description: Your Weapon Enchantments have a |cffffff10|r% chance to not consume a charge when activated per stage.

10.name: Rationer
10.description: Adds |cffffff10|r minutes to the duration of any food or drink that increases your character's stats per stage.

11.name: Liquid Efficiency
11.description: Whenever you use a potion or poison you have a |cffffff10|r% chance to not consume it.

12.name: Angler's Instincts
12.description: Increases your chance of catching higher quality fish, akin to fishing with another player. This effect can stack with other similar bonuses.

13.name: Reel Technique
13.description: Decreases the time it takes for a fish to bite by |cffffff25|r%.

14.name: Homemaker
14.description: You have a |cffffff10|r% chance to find a second furnishing plan whenever you find a furnishing plan in the world.

15.name: Wanderer
15.description: Reduces the cost of Wayshrine usage by |cffffff10|r% per stage.

16.name: Plentiful Harvest
16.description: You have a |cffffff10|r% chance to gain double the yield from normal resource nodes per stage.

17.name: War Mount
17.description: Improves your mastery with mounts, removing all mount Stamina costs outside of combat.

18.name: Gifted Rider
18.description: Increases your Mount Speed by |cffffff2|r% per stage.

19.name: Meticulous Disassembly
19.description: Improves the chances of extracting Woodworking, Blacksmithing, Clothing, and Jewelry Crafting ingredients and allows the refining of more powerful resins, tempers, tannins, and platings from raw materials.

20.name: Inspiration Boost
20.description: Increases your crafting inspiration gained by |cffffff10|r% per stage.

21.name: Fortune's Favor
21.description: Increases the amount of gold you find in treasure chests and safeboxes by |cffffff10|r% per stage.

22.name: Infamous
22.description: Increases the value of fenced items by |cffffff25|r%.

23.name: Fleet Phantom
23.description: Reduces the Movement Speed penalty of Sneak by |cffffff5|r% per stage.

24.name: Gilded Fingers
24.description: Increases your gold gained by |cffffff2|r% per stage.

25.name: Breakfall
25.description: Reduces your fall damage taken by |cffffff7|r% per stage.

26.name: Soul Reservoir
26.description: When you resurrect yourself or another player you have a |cffffff33|r% chance to not consume a Soul Gem.

27.name: Steed's Blessing
27.description: Increases your out of combat Movement Speed by |cffffff.4|r% per stage.

28.name: Sustaining Shadows
28.description: Reduces the cost of Sneak by |cffffff1|r% per stage.

29.name: Professional Upkeep
29.description: Reduces the cost of repairing your armor by |cffffff1|r% per stage.

1.name: Precision
1.description: Grants |cffffff160|r Critical Chance per stage.

2.name: Fighting Finesse
2.description: Increases your Critical Damage and Critical Healing done by |cffffff4|r% per stage.

bounsText.0: |cffffff0|r% Critical Damage and Critical Healing done
bounsText.25: |cffffff4|r% Critical Damage and Critical Healing done
bounsText.50: |cffffff8|r% Critical Damage and Critical Healing done

3.name: Blessed
3.description: Increases your Healing Done by |cffffff1|r% per stage.

4.name: From the Brink
4.description: Whenever you heal yourself or an ally under |cffffff25|r% Health, you grant them a damage shield that absorbs up to |cffffff2200|r damage per stage, for |cffffff6|r seconds. This effect can occur once every |cffffff30|r seconds per target.

5.name: Enlivening Overflow
5.description:
Overhealing yourself or an ally grants them Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery equal to |cffffff.5|r% of your Max Magicka, up to a cap of |cffffff150|r, for |cffffff6|r seconds. This effect can occur once every |cffffff12|r seconds per target.

Current bonus: |cffffff89|r

6.name: Hope Infusion
6.description:
Healing yourself or an ally under |cffffff50|r% Health grants them Minor Heroism for |cffffff1|r second for every |cffffff300|r Magicka Recovery you have. This effect can occur once every |cffffff10|r seconds per target.

Current duration: |cffffff2|r seconds

7.name: Salve of Renewal
7.description: Whenever you remove a harmful effect from yourself or an ally, you sanctify the ground beneath them and heal them and allies within |cffffff8|r meters for |cffffff1408|r Health per stage. This effect can occur once every |cffffff10|r seconds.

8.name: Soothing Tide
8.description: Increases your Healing Done by area of effect heals by |cffffff2|r% per stage.

9.name: Rejuvenator
9.description: Grants |cffffff41|r Weapon and Spell Damage to your healing abilities per stage.

10.name: Foresight
10.description: After you drink a potion, the cost of your Magicka and Stamina healing abilities used within |cffffff6|r seconds are reduced by |cffffff75|r%.

11.name: Cleansing Revival
11.description: Healing a target under |cffffff25|r% Health removes all harmful effects from them. This effect can occur once every |cffffff24|r seconds.

12.name: Focused Mending
12.description: Increases your Healing Done with single target heals by |cffffff2|r% per stage.

13.name: Swift Renewal
13.description: Increases your Healing Done with healing over time effects by |cffffff2|r% per stage.

15.name: Exploiter
15.description: Increases your damage done against Off Balance enemies by |cffffff2|r% per stage.

16.name: Force of Nature
16.description: Increases your Offensive Penetration by |cffffff660|r for every status effect your target has.

17.name: Master-at-Arms
17.description: Increases your damage done with direct damage attacks by |cffffff3|r% per stage.

18.name: Weapons Expert
18.description: Increases your damage done with Light and Heavy Attacks by |cffffff4|r% per stage.

19.name: Flawless Ritual
19.description: Increases your chance to apply a Magical status effect by |cffffff30|r% per stage.

20.name: War Mage
20.description:
Grants |cffffff100|r Weapon and Spell Damage to Magical attacks.

Affects Magic, Flame, Frost, and Shock Damage.

21.name: Battle Mastery
21.description: Increases your chance to apply a Martial status effect by |cffffff30|r% per stage.

22.name: Mighty
22.description:
Grants |cffffff100|r Weapon and Spell Damage to Martial attacks.

Affects Physical, Poison, Disease, and Bleed Damage.

23.name: Deadly Aim
23.description: Increase your damage done with single target attacks by |cffffff3|r% per stage.

24.name: Biting Aura
24.description: Increases your damage done with area of effect attacks by |cffffff3|r% per stage.

25.name: Thaumaturge
25.description: Increases your damage done with damage over time effects by |cffffff3|r% per stage.

26.name: Reaving Blows
26.description: When you deal direct damage you heal for |cffffff8|r% of the damage done.

27.name: Wrathful Strikes
27.description: Grants |cffffff41|r Weapon and Spell Damage to your damaging abilities per stage.

28.name: Occult Overload
28.description: Whenever you kill an enemy under the effect of a status effect, they violently explode for |cffffff1037|r Oblivion Damage per stage to all other enemies in a |cffffff4|r meter radius, and applying a random status effect to each enemy hit. This effect can occur once every second.

29.name: Backstabber
29.description: Increases your Critical Damage done by |cffffff2|r% per stage against enemies you are flanking.

31.name: Quick Recovery
31.description: Increases your healing received by |cffffff1|r% per stage.

32.name: Ironclad
32.description: Reduces your damage taken by direct damage attacks by |cffffff3|r% per stage.

34.name: Preparation
34.description: Reduces your damage taken from non-player attacks by |cffffff5|r% per stage.

35.name: Elemental Aegis
35.description:
Reduces the damage you take from Magical attacks by |cffffff1|r% per stage.

Affects Magic, Flame, Frost, and Shock Damage.

36.name: Hardy
36.description:
Reduces the damage you take from Martial attacks by |cffffff1|r% per stage.

Affects Physical, Poison, Disease, and Bleed Damage.

37.name: Enduring Resolve
37.description: Reduces your damage taken by damage over time attacks by |cffffff3|r% per stage.

38.name: Reinforced
38.description: When you begin Bracing, you gain a damage shield that absorbs |cffffff5140|r damage for |cffffff3|r seconds. This effect can occur once every |cffffff10|r seconds.

39.name: Riposte
39.description: When you block an attack from an enemy within |cffffff7|r meters, your next direct damage attack made within |cffffff5|r seconds deals |cffffff33|r% additional damage. This effect can occur once every |cffffff5|r seconds.

40.name: Bulwark
40.description: While you have a Shield or Frost Staff equipped, your Spell and Physical Resistance is increased by |cffffff1900|r.

41.name: Last Stand
41.description: When you take damage below |cffffff20|r% Health you gain Major Heroism, granting |cffffff3|r Ultimate every |cffffff1.5|r seconds for |cffffff9|r seconds. This effect can occur once every |cffffff9|r seconds.

42.name: Cutting Defense
42.description: You deal |cffffff359|r Magic Damage to attackers whenever they damage you with a direct damage attack within |cffffff7|r meters. This effect scales off the higher of your Physical or Spell Resistance and can activate your Weapon Enchantments and Poisons.

43.name: Duelist's Rebuff
43.description: Reduces your damage taken by single target attacks by |cffffff3|r% per stage.

44.name: Unassailable
44.description: Reduces your damage taken by area of effect attacks by |cffffff3|r% per stage.

46.name: Endless Endurance
46.description: Increases your Max Stamina by |cffffff26|r per stage.

47.name: Untamed Aggression
47.description: Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff3|r per stage.

48.name: Arcane Supremacy
48.description: Increases Max Magicka by |cffffff26|r per stage.

1.name: Sprinter
1.description: Reduces the cost of Sprint by |cffffff20|r Stamina per stage.
